# Administrative Assistant III

$55.37k - $62.29k

Jt4, Llc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6562590030676883860?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1553026867323718166&crId=US_0US_0)

Administrative Assistant III#12382Edwards AFB, California, United StatesApply### Job CategoryADMIN### Work LocationCalifornia - Lancaster / Palmdale / Edwards AFB### Job DescriptionJT4, LLC provides engineering and technical support to multiple western test ranges for the U.S. Air Force, Space Force, and Navy under the Joint Range Technical Services Contract, better known as J-Tech II. JT4 develops and maintains realistic, integrated test and training environments and prepares our nation's war-fighting aircraft, weapons systems, and aircrews for today's missions and tomorrow's global challenges.\*\*JOB DUTIES - ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS\*\*Under limited supervision, an Administrative Assistant III provides administrative support services on behalf of a business unit or department and may provide work direction to less experienced clerical or administrative personnel. The work product facilitates the work of others within the immediate organizational unit.Employee will be responsible for the following functions/duties:\* Respond to inquiries using initiative and judgment based on in-depth knowledge of policies and procedures\* Issue and interpret operating procedures\* Perform a variety of administrative functions related to departmental operations, personnel and staffing, security, payroll, and general office management\* Maintain, gather, correlate, and analyze operating reports such as time and attendance records, terminations, new hires, transfers, records of performance, security, and other personnel data\* Prepare and/or assist in the development of budgets, forecasts, manpower planning, and related organizational data\* Schedule appointments, arrange travel plans, coordinate meetings, and prepare meeting materials\* Review and respond to correspondence and requests\* Screen, direct, and manage incoming telephone calls\* Act as a liaison for internal and external visitors\* Perform other job-related duties, as required\*\*REQUIREMENTS - EDUCATION, TECHNICAL, AND WORK EXPERIENCE\*\*A high school diploma, or equivalent, completion of formal training in administrative areas, and five (5) or more years of experience in an administrative position are required for this position.In addition, an Administrative Assistant III must possess the following qualifications:\* Proficiency in the use of the Internet, personal computers, word processing, spreadsheet and graphics/presentation software, and other commonly used electronic communication tools\* Strong verbal and written communication skills\* Excellent planning/organizational skills\* Must possess a valid, state issued driver’s license\* Must be able to obtain and maintain security clearance\* Must be a U.S. citizen\*\*SALARY\*\*The expected salary range for this position is $55,369.60 to $62,290.80 annually.\*\*Note:\*\* The salary range offered for this position is a good faith description of the expected salary range this role will pay. JT4, LLC considers factors such as (but not limited to) responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and business considerations when extending an offer.\*\*BENEFITS\*\*\* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance+ Benefits Active on Day 1\* Life Insurance\* Health Savings Accounts/FSA's\* Disability Insurance\* Paid Time Off\* 401(k) Plan Options with Employer Match+ JT4 will match 50%, up to an 8% contribution+ 100% Immediate Vesting\* Tuition Reimbursement\*\*OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES\*\*Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality, and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures, and policies pertaining to their job.\*\*WORKING CONDITIONS\*\*Work is performed in a typical office environment. Some walking, stooping, bending, climbing stairs, stretching, and lifting (up to 25 pounds) is required for purposes such as gathering supplies.Travel to remote company work locations may be required.\*\*DISCLAIMER\*\*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of persons so classified.Tasking is in support of a Federal Government Contract that requires U.S. citizenship. Some jobs may require a candidate to be eligible for a government security clearance, state-issued driver’s license, or other licenses/certifications, and the inability to obtain and maintain the required clearance, license, or certification may affect an employee’s ability to maintain employment.

# Senior Marketing Specialist - AMS&T

$105k - $150k

Gilbane Building

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4065856163365739812?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=252575254503020846&crId=US_0US_0)

Overview
The Senior Marketing Specialist is a lead for the (Advanced Manufacturing, Science & Technology (AMS&T) vertical business and works independently to develop complex and technical sales, marketing, and communications deliverables and leads strategic pursuits and campaigns.

Overview
The Senior Marketing Specialist is a lead for the (Advanced Manufacturing, Science & Technology (AMS&T) vertical business and works independently to develop complex and technical sales, marketing, and communications deliverables and leads strategic pursuits and campaigns.

This position can be performed from any U.S. location where Gilbane has an office.

Who are we?
As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!
We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?
You are a coach/leader who leads with an inclusive and empathetic mindset. You provide feedback and guidance to help others excel in their current or future roles. You determine priorities, delegate work, and effectively communicate progress. You establish measures to assess the impact, quality, and timeliness of results while praising successes and sharing lessons learned. You build high performing teams by attracting, engaging, developing, and retaining talented individuals through motivation and discipline to maximize impact on the organization and the individual.
You leverage business insights by understanding industry trends, local market/economic conditions, and Gilbane’s business model to make critical decisions and create competitive advantage. You deploy a strategic mindset when considering solutions to long-term opportunities and risks that may develop in the future.
Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?
Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

Independently lead the development and production of client qualifications, proposals, and presentations with a focus on quality, creativity, and meeting client deadlines.

Ability to manage content development and pursuit process directly with business development , operations and AMS&T leadership .

Craft compelling story content about clients, projects, people, and Gilbane and incorporate these differentiators into deliverables that address the unique client needs .

Ensure all external content and client deliverables align with Gilbane’s brand standards and messaging guidelines.

Active participant in presell meetings and strategic brainstorms.

Development of AMS&T marketing, including conferences and tradeshows (in partnership with enterprise marcom team), speaking submissions, marketing collateral and materials, and strategic support for priority projects.

Lead the development of internal and external communications, including newsletters, press releases, website content, social media posts, eblasts, and content for other digital channels.

Oversee the organization and maintenance of digital assets, ensuring efficient categorization and searchability, while providing guidance and support to entry-level team members.

Accountable for data maintenance to ensure data integrity.

Conduct research for the AMS&T vertical to understand our clients – who they are, what’s top of mind and key trends. Analyze, interpret, and communicate research with BD partners and leadership as needed.

Lead close-out process of sales and marketing deliverables.

Develop a strong knowledge of the AEC industry , AMS&T vertical, and Gilbane’s capabilities across each sector, locally and nationally.

Strong leadership in building and maintaining a robust operational network to facilitate storytelling and identify value adds about our projects.

Visit jobsites regularly to enhance operational partnerships, take photos, and interview project teams for future content opportunities. Ensure content is organized and cataloged for future use.

Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality external content and client deliverables, ensuring clear communication, mutual support, and a cohesive approach to problem -solving.

Mentor and train junior staff.

Independently lead multiple deliverables concurrently and has a strong ability to multi-task.

Participate in professional or AMS&T organizations and begin to explore opportunities for committee or other leadership opportunities.

Stay abreast of new marcom trends and tools .

Experience/Education
Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

7+ years relevant experience in the marketing and/or AEC industry

Demonstrated experience and knowledge of AMS&T markets including advanced technology, data centers, life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, semiconductor, and food & beverage/consumer goods facilities, key market terminology, and processes.

Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Technical Skills: Advanced skills in Adobe Create Suite, Power Point, Unanet, AI technology tools, and Photography

Professional Development: Excellent time management, organization, and communication skills; excels in working independently and collaboratively in a team; advanced writing and critical thinking skills; strong at process management

Business Acumen: Mastery of Gilbane services and advanced knowledge of construction management and industry awareness as a whole

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

The pay ranges from $105,000.00-$150,000.00 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Gilbane is an affirmative action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

### Job Description

Job Description

Crusoe is on a mission _to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence_ . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As a Senior Construction Scheduler at Crusoe, you will play a key role in supporting the planning, coordination, and delivery of large-scale infrastructure critical to Crusoe’s mission. This position will ensure accurate, timely scheduling and forecasting of project timelines using Primavera P6 across our data center developments.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

- Develop and manage comprehensive construction project schedules using Primavera P6 for Crusoe’s hyperscale data center initiatives

- Collaborate with development, construction, engineering, and operations teams to maintain milestone programs and ensure alignment with overall project goals

- Perform schedule risk assessments and support mitigation planning

- Lead critical path and near-critical path reviews with cross-functional stakeholders

- Generate schedule reports and support project controls team with analytics and forecast updates

- Coordinate scope alignment with trades and internal and external teams to ensure schedule accuracy

- Provide recovery plans and corrective action guidance when delays or risks are identified

- Track schedule deliverables, dependencies, facilitate schedule review meetings, and provide what-if scenario analysis with

- Support reporting requirements for leadership, clients, and regulatory compliance

- Conduct regular site visits to assess progress and validate contractor performance against schedule


**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

- 5+ years of hands-on experience with Primavera P6 or MS Project on large-scale construction projects

- Experience with data centers, high-tech infrastructure, or mission-critical facilities strongly preferred

- Familiarity with float management, critical path method (CPM), and sequencing logic

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)

- Strong communication skills; ability to synthesize complex schedule data into clear concise updates for internal and external stakeholders and leadership

- Proficiency in Primavera P6, Smartsheet and Microsoft Office

- Certifications such as PMP, PSP (AACE), or CMMA a plus


**Benefits:**

- Competitive compensation

- Restricted Stock Units

- Paid time off & paid holidays

- Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

- Employer contributions to HSA account

- Paid parental leave

- Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

- Professional development & tuition reimbursement

- Mental health & wellness support

- Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

- Cell phone stipend

- 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

- Volunteer time off


**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $165,000-$210,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

## Sutter Health Job Posting

We are so glad you are interested in joining Sutter Health!

Organization: SPMF-Sutter Pacific Medical Foundation - South

Position Overview:

Maintains scheduling for surgical and specialized procedures for assigned department(s). Coordinates surgical services with physicians' offices, and other related departments and may be required to verify room and equipment availability. Responsible for documentation of patient's procedure and physician information; logs the completed procedures; and may generate a surgical procedure charge sheet. Performs additional associated duties as requested by manager, while simultaneously ensuring the accuracy of the schedule.

Job Description:

These Principal Accountabilities, Requirements and Qualifications are not exhaustive, but are merely the most descriptive of the current job. Management reserves the right to revise the job description or require that other tasks be performed when the circumstances of the job change (for example, emergencies, staff changes, workload, or technical development). JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES: SURGERY SCHEDULING: Schedules surgeries and specialized procedures according to department protocols. Confirms scheduled surgeries against surgeons allotted times and may need to verify room availability, equipment and supply requirements. Schedules surgical procedures using organization's protocols for scheduling block time or open availability and enters data into an established database. Organizes, reschedules and updates changes made to schedules, may need to provide follow up calls to patients and provide rescheduled dates imes. Coordinates open clinic times when physician does not have scheduled surgical cases. Documents all procedures scheduled accurately and according to department protocols. Ensures accurate coordination of authorizations prior to scheduled procedures. Verifies and coordinates insurance eligibility and referrals for patients based on department requirements. Facilitates transfer of patients for appropriate services when needed. Provides ownership of specialized projects or reports based on assigned department. Performs additional duties which may include floating to other related areas for support. Orders appropriate supplies and stocks appropriate workstations.COMMUNICATION: Collaborates with department staff and providers to ensure all necessary equipment and/or vendors are requested. Provides treatment instructions other related information, as needed. Participates with training of new hires within the department.

EDUCATION: HS Diploma or General Education Diploma (GED)TYPICAL EXPERIENCE: 2 years recent relevant experience.SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE: Organizational and multi-tasking skills.Intermediate computer skills to include keyboarding, mouse movement, data entry and scheduling programs.Verbal/written communication skills for frequent and challenging contact with physicians, employees, patients and patient families; requires patience and compassion.Ability to effectively organize and prioritize tasks in order to complete assignments within the time allotted and maintain standard workflow.Ability to work with others in a flexible and cooperative manner.Ability to maintain composure during challenging interpersonal interactions.Active listening skills; including interpersonal skills and telephone communication.Ability to handle multiple procedures and interruptions throughout the day.

Job Shift: Days

Schedule: Full Time

Shift Hours: 8

Days of the Week: Monday - Friday

Weekend Requirements: None

Benefits: Yes

Unions: No

Position Status: Non-Exempt

Weekly Hours: 40

Employee Status: Regular

Sutter Health is an equal opportunity employer EOE/M/F/Disability/Veterans.

Pay Range is $33.52 to $46.92 / hour

The compensation range may vary based on the geographic location where the position is filled. Total compensation considers multiple factors, including, but not limited to a candidate's experience, education, skills, licensure, certifications, departmental equity, training, and organizational needs. Base pay is only one component of Sutter Health's comprehensive total rewards program. Eligible positions also include a comprehensive benefits package.

# Scheduler III

$146k - $160k

Blue Stone Management

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/144798647401404811?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=210&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2829440623756060402&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Scheduler III**

**Location:** Los Angeles County, CA

**Hybrid, 2 days remote**

**Salary Range**

**Scheduler III – $146,000 - $160,000**

**WHO WE ARE**

At Blue Stone Management, we're more than project and construction managers, we're trusted advisors, problem-solvers, and partners in delivering projects that make a difference.

From aviation and infrastructure to public facilities and complex capital improvement programs, we bring expertise, collaboration, and innovative thinking to every project we undertake.

We're looking for an experienced **Scheduler III** professional to join our team and support a significant disaster recovery and rebuilding initiative in Los Angeles County.

If you're a detail-oriented scheduling professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys managing complex, high-impact programs, we'd love to hear from you!

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Project Scheduling & Program Management**

- Develop, maintain, and update comprehensive project schedules from design through construction and closeout.
- Create critical path method (CPM) baseline schedules and manage regular updates to monitor project progress.
- Build and maintain an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent capital projects.
- Perform resource loading, cost loading, and earned value analysis to support project performance reporting.
- Identify critical milestones, scheduling conflicts, and potential delays that could impact project delivery.

**Schedule Analysis & Reporting**

- Review contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, and recovery schedules to ensure compliance with contractual requirements.
- Prepare and evaluate time impact analyses, delay claims, and schedule recovery strategies.
- Assess external scheduling factors, including community meetings, concurrent partner agency activities, and funding requirements.
- Develop look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, schedule narratives, and executive-level progress summaries.
- Monitor schedule performance and recommend corrective actions to keep projects on track.

**Collaboration & Risk Management**

- Work closely with project managers, design consultants, contractors, and partner agencies to coordinate schedules and project milestones.
- Identify potential schedule risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize project delays.
- Present schedule updates, critical path analyses, and project progress reports to management and key stakeholders.
- Support project teams in managing competing priorities and adapting to evolving program requirements.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

- **Scheduler III:** Minimum **15 years of project scheduling experience** on public capital improvement or construction projects.
- **Minimum 5 years of experience** planning and scheduling public sector construction projects from design through construction and closeout.
- Educational background in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
- Demonstrated experience developing and managing CPM baseline schedules and integrated master schedules.
- Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, project controls, schedule analysis, and delay mitigation.
- Experience reviewing contractor schedules, analyzing delays, and preparing time impact analyses.
- Ability to manage scheduling requirements across multiple concurrent projects.
- Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting complex scheduling information to management and stakeholders.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing project priorities.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

- Advanced proficiency in **Primavera P6** and **Microsoft Project** .
- Expertise in Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling, baseline development, and schedule updates.
- Experience with resource loading, cost loading, and earned value reporting.
- Ability to develop integrated master schedules, schedule narratives, and project performance dashboards.
- Proficiency in schedule risk assessments, time impact analyses, and delay evaluations.

**BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE**

- Experience supporting disaster recovery, rebuilding, or post-disaster capital improvement programs.
- Experience managing schedules for large-scale, multi-project public works programs.
- Familiarity with public/government agencies.

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE**

At Blue Stone Management, we believe great projects start with great people. You'll have the opportunity to:

- **Make a difference:** Contribute to a major rebuilding initiative that supports community recovery and long-term infrastructure improvements.
- **Work on impactful projects:** Support a diverse portfolio of capital projects with a combined estimated value of approximately $800 million.
- **Collaborate with industry professionals:** Work alongside experienced project managers, engineers, consultants, and public agency partners.
- **Take ownership:** Play a key role in developing scheduling strategies that drive successful project delivery.

_Blue Stone Management is an equal opportunity employer._

# Senior Scheduler (Public Works)

Cordoba Corporation

[Alhambra, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Alhambra%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4915854676329907749?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6408&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3499729730468779101&crId=US_0US_0)

Cordoba Corporation is a leading engineering and design firm based in California. We are seeking a Senior Scheduler to join our Facilities Sector. The ideal candidate will provide senior-level scheduling leadership and project controls oversight for a portfolio of recovery and rebuild capital improvement projects with an estimated program value of approximately $800 million. This position is responsible for developing and managing integrated master schedules, leading schedule risk assessments, evaluating project impacts, and providing executive-level reporting to support strategic program delivery.

The Senior Scheduler serves as the lead scheduling authority for complex, multi-project programs and works closely with executive leadership, project managers, consultants, contractors, utilities, permitting agencies, and partner jurisdictions to ensure projects are delivered in accordance with approved schedules, budgets, and recovery milestones. The ideal candidate possesses extensive experience in program-level scheduling, delay analysis, critical path management, and capital project controls within large public-sector infrastructure and construction environments.

Responsibilities

Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of integrated master program schedules encompassing planning, design, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and project close-out activities.

Establish scheduling standards, methodologies, reporting protocols, and project controls procedures for recovery and rebuild programs.

Develop and maintain critical path method (CPM) schedules for multiple concurrent capital projects and ensure alignment among project schedules, funding milestones, and program objectives.

Manage program-level schedule integration across multiple projects, agencies, utility providers, contractors, and stakeholder groups.

Analyze schedule performance and identify critical path activities, near-critical paths, constraints, float erosion, schedule variances, and risks.

Lead schedule risk assessments and develop recovery strategies, mitigation plans, and what-if analyses to address potential delays and project impacts.

Review and approve contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, recovery schedules, and schedule forecasts for compliance with contract requirements and industry best practices.

Evaluate and negotiate time extension requests, schedule impacts, delay claims, and Time Impact Analyses (TIA).

Perform forensic schedule analysis and provide recommendations regarding entitlement, causation, and mitigation of delays.

Support earned value management, cost-loaded scheduling, cash-flow forecasting, and resource planning activities.

Coordinate with Project Managers, consultants, contractors, permitting agencies, utility companies, and partner jurisdictions to identify project interdependencies and scheduling constraints.

Prepare and present schedule analyses, forecasts, risk assessments, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Monitor schedule compliance across the program and ensure consistency with funding requirements, contractual obligations, and project delivery objectives.

Support disaster recovery and rebuilding initiatives by establishing schedule governance processes and accelerating project delivery strategies where necessary.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Engineering, Project Controls, or a related field.

Minimum 15 years of project scheduling experience on large public-sector capital improvement, infrastructure, transportation, utility, or construction projects.

Education background in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field.

Ability to develop critical path method (CPM) baseline schedules and maintain them through regular updates.

Ability to build and maintain an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent projects.

Skilled in reviewing contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, and recovery schedules for compliance with contract requirements; incorporation of other schedule impact factors, such as community meetings, partner agency concurrent work, and funding sources.

Ability to prepare and evaluate time impact analyses and delay claims.

Ability to perform resource loading and cost loading, and to support earned value reporting.

Ability to produce clear schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and executive-level summaries

Effective oral and written communication skills, including presenting schedule status to management.

Ability to coordinate with project managers, design consultants, contractors, and partner agencies to identify schedule risks and mitigation options.

Ability to adapt and respond effectively to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with disaster recovery or post-disaster rebuild programs.

Salary Range: $166,000 to $183,000 yearly

Location: Alhambra, CA

Work Environment: Onsite

Belmont Village

##### Join Belmont Village Rancho Santa Fe

Be part of the Belmont Village Rancho Santa Fe legacy! As we are preparing for the grand opening of our brand-new, state-of-the-art senior living community nestled in the gated community of Lakes at Rancho Santa Fe, we're building an incredible team from the ground up. At Belmont Village Rancho Santa Fe, you'll help shape a vibrant, hospitality-driven environment where seniors thrive—and where team members learn, grow, and feel valued every day.

If you're ready to join a company where hospitality, innovation and human connection come together, APPLY TODAY and be among the first to hear about upcoming hiring events!

YOUR TYPICAL RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop and maintain 24/7 employee work schedules using OnShift, proactively ensuring appropriate staffing coverage and responding to call-offs, approved time off and changing operational needs
- Apply sound judgement and critical thinking to balance staffing requirements, employee availability, equitable distribution of hours and labor costs while minimizing overtime and contract labor
- Build collaborative relationships with employees and department leaders to anticipate staffing needs, resolve scheduling challenges and communicate schedule changes effectively
- Coordinate new hire training schedules and assist with the employee orientation and onboarding process
- Provide administrative support for payroll, time and attendance, department supplies and related workforce records including data entry and use of ADP.
- Demonstrate exceptional hospitality and customer service in every interaction supporting a positive employee experience and exceptional service to residents.

The certification says Great Place to Work®. Our employees tell us why: meaningful work, a welcoming culture, and the opportunity to make a difference.

THE BELMONT VILLAGE DIFFERENCE

- Learn, Develop & Grow – Strengthen your skills with access to on-demand educational content and participate in specialized training led by our Learning & Development experts
- Internal Career Growth – Enhance your skills, take on new challenges, and build a long-term career with us
- Stability You Can Trust – Experienced leaders and long-tenured teams provide support you can count on
- Belonging & Recognition – Diverse perspectives are valued, contributions are recognized, and achievements are celebrated
- Support When It Matters – BV Cares provides direct employee assistance during severe and unexpected hardships

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- High School diploma or equivalent
- Prior experience managing employee/workforce scheduling in a 24/7 operation in healthcare, senior living, hospitality or similar business model
- Experience using employee scheduling/workforce management software such as OnShift strongly preferred
- Must be able to communicate clearly in verbal and written English
- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound staffing decisions in a dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build productive professional relationships with frontline employees and department leaders
- Must be able to effectively use company issued electronic devices such as tablets, smartphones, and laptops for job-related tasks
- Consistent and reliable attendance is essential for all Belmont Village employees to ensure the successful operation of the community

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Founded in Houston in 1997, Belmont Village is an integrated developer, owner, and operator of high-quality senior living communities, with more than 5,000 employees and 5,000 units. Our 35 locations across the country and in Mexico City, provide award-winning independent, assisted living and memory care programs. We are proud to collaborate with UC San Diego, USC, UCLA, and Baptist Health South Florida to innovate programs for cognitive health and life enrichment. Belmont Village is a market leader in major markets including the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, San Diego, Chicago and South Florida. Renowned for distinctive design, high standards of life and safety, and reputation for leading edge, quality programming, Belmont Village has been certified as a Great Place to Work® since 2018 and has been recognized by U.S News & World Report as Best in Senior Living.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE

Belmont Village Senior Living offers full-time employees medical, dental, vision, mental health, and prescription benefits along with Paid Time Off, flexible spending account, 401(k) savings with employer match, short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance.

EOE

Belmont Village Senior Living is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

# Senior Executive Assistant to The President of Software - (Location-Onsite - Menlo Park, CA)

Salary: 120400-189200 per yearLocation:San Jose, CACompany:FICO

## Description:

**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

**The Opportunity**

As Senior Executive Assistant, you will serve as strategic partner to the President of Software and their leadership team — trusted not just to manage an executive's schedule, but to extend their judgment and priorities across the business. You will own executive administration and high-discretion projects end-to-end, moving fluidly from coordinating a critical customer meeting to shaping stakeholder communication to driving a cross-functional initiative to the finish line. This is a role for someone who wants more than a traditional EA position offers — real latitude to make decisions, direct access to senior leadership, and the opportunity to run initiatives rather than simply support them.

**What You’ll Contribute**

- Provide primary administrative support to the President, with overflow assistance to other executives as needed, working independently across a wide range of activities.
- Own initiatives end-to-end for the President of Software — building project plans, tracking milestones, and driving accountability across stakeholders who don't report to you, from kickoff through completion.
- Anticipate needs before they're voiced, running ahead of the executive's calendar and priorities rather than reacting to them, and making independent decisions within a defined scope, escalating only what truly requires their input.
- Serve as a trusted gatekeeper for the President's time and information, communicating on their behalf with internal and external stakeholders and exercising sound judgment on tone, content, and timing — including sensitive correspondence — while handling all confidential business information with absolute discretion.
- Manage complex, high-volume calendars across time zones, protecting focus time and prioritizing strategic importance rather than "first ask, first served".
- Coordinate recurring leadership cadences — staff meeting agendas, all-hands prep, offsite planning, quarterly business reviews — and prepare polished executive-level presentations and briefing materials for leadership and client audiences.
- Maintain a single source of truth for the executive's active commitments, open items, and follow-ups, and track budgets and spend for executive-sponsored initiatives, producing regular status reports for leadership.
- Coordinate domestic and international travel — including commercial and private air — managing real-time adjustments to complex global itineraries.
- Process travel and expense reports accurately and on time, ensuring compliance with company policy, and support periodic personal coordination needs.
- Provide backup office-support coverage for the Menlo Park, California office when the Office Administrator is out

**What We’re Seeking**

- Proven experience supporting senior executives (EVP and above), including managing projects that extend well beyond administrative support, in a global, fast-paced environment.
- Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the polish to engage credibly with C-suite executives, board members, clients, and vendors.
- A track record of owning a budget, project, or initiative through to a measurable outcome — not simply having "assisted with" one.
- Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and competing, time-sensitive priorities independently, anticipating needs rather than waiting to be asked.
- Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to draft confidently in the executive's voice rather than simply formatting what's handed to you.
- Skill in gathering and synthesizing information from multiple sources into clear, executive-ready presentations.
- Fluent with Microsoft 365 and modern AI tools used to accelerate drafting and triage; hands-on experience with Claude strongly preferred.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); additional proficiency with Apple applications and project management tools is highly preferred
- A bachelor's degree — ideally in business, communications, or a related field — or equivalent experience supporting senior executives.


**Our Offer to You**

- An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
- The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
- Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
- An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
- The targeted base pay range for this role is: $120,400 to $189,200 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

# Senior Administrative Specialist – Onsite (Los Angeles, CA)

Salary: 30 per hourLocation:Dowtown Carrier Annex, CACompany:Universal Strategic Advisors

## Description:

**Administrative Specialist – Onsite – \[Los Angeles, CA\]**

**Company**

Universal Strategic Advisors LLC (US Advisors) is a small business consulting firm. We specialize in government administration, technology implementation, law enforcement operations, homeland security, immigration operations, border security and compliance. We give our federal clients deep subject-matter expertise and a trusted network so they can meet mission demands while managing risk.

**Position Summary**

US Advisors is hiring a highly organized, detail-oriented Senior Administrative Specialist to provide onsite administrative, data and program support to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) within the **Los Angeles** Area of Responsibility (AOR). The Senior Administrative Specialist supports office operations and the processes for individuals in ICE custody and individuals reporting to ICE offices. This role also serves as a team lead. The Senior Administrative Specialist coordinates the daily work of other Administrative Specialists, serves as the primary point of contact for ICE personnel, and keeps the team’s work accurate, timely and consistent. The ideal candidate is bilingual in English and Spanish, an experienced and dependable leader, and able to manage several priorities at once while maintaining strict confidentiality.

**Responsibilities**

- **Team lead and coordination:** Coordinate the daily work of the onsite Administrative Specialist team. Assign and balance tasks, monitor workload, and adjust coverage across shifts to meet office needs.
- **Training and quality review:** Train and mentor new and current specialists on procedures, systems and confidentiality requirements. Review completed work for accuracy and completeness, and correct problems before they reach Government personnel.
- **Primary point of contact:** Serve as the team’s main liaison with Government personnel and the Company's program management. Receive taskings, communicate priorities to the team, and raise issues for resolution.
- **Administrative documentation:** Prepare, organize and maintain administrative records related to office processing, and file documents electronically following established procedures.
- **Data entry and data management:** Enter, validate and update information accurately in designated government systems, including individual records, status information and tracking details as directed by Government personnel. Keep data complete, current and consistent, and flag discrepancies or missing information for resolution.
- **Data reporting:** Monitor key data points and prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, trackers and summaries for office leadership. Consolidate team inputs into accurate, on-time products.
- **Appointment scheduling and tracking:** Schedule, check and track appointments, and see that the related paperwork and notices are prepared and filed on time.
- **Program management support:** Provide administrative and documentation support for office initiatives. Identify and recommend process improvements based on workflow and data trends, and help put approved changes in place across the team.
- **Communications and taskings support:** Support taskings, data calls, travel authorizations and itineraries, and other communications initiatives as defined by the Government.
- **Budget support:** Help track budgets, expenditures and related reporting.
- **Document control and compliance:** Maintain organized physical and electronic files. Make sure the team follows all applicable confidentiality, privacy and records-handling requirements.
- **Front-office and clerical support:** Assist individuals reporting to the office with professionalism and courtesy, and give general clerical support to Government personnel as directed.

**Required Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
- At least ten years of professional experience in administrative support, data management, program support or a related field.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), including working with data in Excel, and comfort learning new software systems.
- Experience entering, maintaining and reporting data with a high degree of accuracy.
- Comfort working in a customer-facing, public-service setting.
- U.S. citizenship.
- Ability to pass and keep a federal background investigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Fluent in English and Spanish in a professional setting (optional).
- Experience supporting a federal, state or local government agency, particularly in law enforcement or immigration operations.
- Experience with budget tracking, travel coordination or program management support.
- Experience training, mentoring or coordinating the work of other staff.
- Strong organizational, analytical and time-management skills.
- Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
- A high level of discretion, professionalism and attention to detail.

**Work Schedule and Location**

- This position is fully onsite at the ICE office in the greater Los Angeles metropolitan area.
- The role follows a shift schedule requiring at least 40 hours of work per week between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM local time, including weekends and holidays.

**Background Investigation**

Each offer is contingent on passing a federal background investigation, which includes a criminal history check and verification of employment history, education and other information the agency requires. Passing the investigation is a condition of employment.

**Compensation**

- $30.00 per hour

**Benefits**

- Health and wellness benefits for eligible employees
- Paid time off for sick leave and vacation
- Paid federal holidays

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

US Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

We're a fast-growing CPG beverage company looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to keep our books clean and our financials accurate. This is a part-time HYBRID role averaging about 80-120 hours per month requiring 1 day a week in-office in Oceanside, CA or Orange County, CA.

**Nice to Have**

- Experience supporting a growing startup or small business
- Familiarity with CPG-specific financials (COGS, inventory, trade spend, etc.)
- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

$75k

San Diego Wave Fútbol Club

## WE’D LOVE FOR YOU TO JOIN US!

San Diego Wave Fútbol Club is on a mission to build a world class home for players and fans. We are seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking individual to join our mission to share our story, win championships, increase, and delight our fans. We’re making memories and engaging our community through this beautiful game.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Executive Assistant serves as a trusted partner to the CEO and Sporting Director, providing high-level administrative, operational, and organizational support that enables both leaders to operate effectively and efficiently. This role manages complex schedules, coordinates key meetings and travel, supports strategic initiatives, facilitates communication across departments, and ensures seamless execution of executive priorities. As a shared Executive Assistant, this position balances the needs of both the business and sporting functions of the club while maintaining flexibility in a dynamic professional sports environment.

Role Responsibilities
Executive Support

Provide dedicated administrative support to the CEO and Sporting Director.

Manage complex calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination for both executives.

Prioritize and resolve scheduling conflicts.

Coordinate meetings with ownership, league representatives, agents, player representatives, ownership, sponsors, and partners.

Prepare agendas, briefing materials, presentations, and reports.

Track action items, deadlines, and commitments.

Coordinate domestic and international travel.

Process expense reports and administrative documentation.

Draft and manage executive correspondence.

Handle confidential information with discretion.

Organizational & Leadership Support

Support Senior Leadership Team meetings and executive planning sessions.

Prepare presentations, reports, and leadership meeting materials.

Facilitate communication between business and sporting departments.

Coordinate executive-level projects and strategic initiatives.

Support Board meetings and executive preparations.

Travel, Meetings & Events

Coordinate meeting logistics, catering, technology, and visitor management.

Support executive offsites, club functions, and league meetings.

Manage executive guest and VIP experiences.

Administrative Operations

Maintain executive records, files, and documentation.

Support document management and administrative workflows.

Assist with special projects and research assignments, including office management initiatives, office space planning, workplace improvements, and other special office projects as needed.

## QUALIFIED?

4+ years supporting senior leaders or executives.

Experience supporting multiple executives preferred.

Exceptional organizational and project management skills.

Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

High level of discretion and confidentiality.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and productivity tools.

Ability to work evenings, weekends, and match days.

Adapt quickly as business needs evolve.

Exceptional at building relationships both internally and externally.

Professional, positive, and proactive.

Passion for the success of Women’s Professional Sports.

This is a full-time, exempt role with a base compensation of $75,000+ DOE.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

# Business Office Assistant at Norwood Pines Alzheimer's Care Center Sacramento, CA

Comunidade Metodista

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4046688671700152185?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2570264086760889185&crId=US_0US_0)

Business Office Assistant job at Norwood Pines Alzheimer's Care Center. Sacramento, CA.

Purpose of Your Job Position
The primary purpose of your job position is to assist the business office manager in completing specific business office duties.

Delegation of Authority
As the Business Office Assistant, you are delegated the administrative authority, responsibility and accountability necessary for carrying out your assigned duties.

Job Functions
Every effort has been made to make your job description as complete as possible. However, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties you will be required to perform.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Greet visitor at the front desk, answering questions and directing them to the appropriate staff members or residents, maintain visitor log.

Answering the telephone, screening calls and forwarding them to the appropriate resident or staff and taking messages.

Check and verify that census information is correct and ready is for distribution and the morning meeting.

Handle and distribute faxes that come in through the facility’s public fax.

Sort and distribute mail.

Order office supplies, business cards and name badges as required.

Distribute facility petty cash and maintain distribution records of cash disbursements, prepare reconciliation request..

Assist with resident trust needs as requested.

Review admission packets to ensure documents are complete.

Payroll functions as outlined: Verify nursing assignment sheet with payroll records daily, prepare daily PPD calculations and daily hour report for the administrator, close payroll, prepare payroll summary report, add new employees to the time clock, verify vacation and sick leave requests, prepare payroll checks for distribution.

Maintain employee and department head telephone emergency call list.

Maintain employee evaluation list.

Respond to employee HR questions, insurance questions and other related issues.

Accounts payable functions as outlined: coping invoices, coding invoices, preparing A/P transmittal before sending them to the home office and arrange pick-up by FedEx.

Assist in monitoring residents during the smoking periods outside in front of the building.

Develop and maintain a good working rapport with management, outside consultants and inter-department personnel, as well as other departments within the facility. Consult with department supervisors concerning their administrative needs, and other related areas, to assist in eliminating/correcting problem areas, and/or improvement of services.

Assist in maintaining a good public relations program that serves the best interest of the facility and community alike by creating and maintaining an atmosphere of warmth, personal interest, and positive emphasis, as well as a calm environment throughout the facility.

Other related duties and responsibilities that may become necessary or as directed by the Business Office Manager.

Resident’s Rights Functions

Maintain confidentiality of all Resident information.

Assure that the Residents’ rights to fair and equitable treatment, self-determination, individuality, privacy, property and civil rights, including the right to wage complaints, are well established and maintained at all times.

Staff Development

Attend and participate in in-service educational classes and on-the-job training programs as directed.

Attend and participate in continuing educational programs designed to keep abreast of changes in his/her profession sometimes provided out of facility.

Working Conditions

Works in well-lighted/ventilated office areas, as well as throughout the facility and its premises.

Sits, stands, bends, lifts and moves intermittently during working hours.

Is subject to frequent interruptions.

Is involved with Residents’ family members, personnel, visitors, government agencies/personnel, etc., under all conditions/circumstances.

Is subject to hostile and emotionally upset Residents, family members, personnel, visitors, etc.

Is subject to falls, burns from equipment, odors, etc. throughout the day.

May be exposed to infectious waste, diseases, conditions, etc., including exposure to the Aids and Hepatitis B viruses.

Communicates with the medical staff, nursing personnel and other department supervisors.

Educational Requirements

Must possess, as a minimum, a High School Diploma. Completion of two years of an accredited Business School is preferred.

Experience

Must have, as a minimum, two (2) years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting practices, preferably in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) setting.

Specific Requirements

Must be able to read, write and speak the English language.

Must possess the ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action.

Must possess the ability to deal tactfully with personnel, Residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel and the general public.

Must be a minimum of 18 years of age and of good moral character.

Must possess the ability to work harmoniously with professional and non-professional personnel.

Must possess the ability to plan, organize, implement, and interpret the programs, goals, objectives, policies, and procedures that are necessary for providing sound accounting techniques.

Physical and Sensory Requirements
(with or without the aid of mechanical devices)

Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday.

Must be able to cope with the mental and emotional stress of the position.

Must possess sight/hearing senses, or use prosthetics that will enable these senses to function adequately so that the requirements of this position can be fully met.

Must function independently, have flexibility, personal integrity, and the ability to work effectively with other personnel.

Must be in good general health and demonstrate emotional stability.

Must be able to relate to and work with ill, disabled, elderly, emotionally upset, or at times hostile people within the facility.

May be required to lift and move business office equipment or supplies.

Reporting Relationship
The Administrator supervises the Business Office Manager.

# Administrative Assistant

Fayetteville Childrens Clinic

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6728032364820597565?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7441396868265928695&crId=US_0US_0)

**Company Description** Fayetteville Childrens Clinic is a health care organization located at 1606 Morganton Road in Fayetteville, North Carolina, serving children and their families in the surrounding community. The clinic focuses on providing accessible pediatric care in a professional and supportive environment. Team members work closely with clinicians and staff to support high-quality, family-centered medical services. The organization values reliability, clear communication, and strong coordination to ensure smooth daily operations. Applicants can expect a collaborative setting dedicated to improving the health and well-being of children.

**Role Description** The Administrative Assistant is a part-time remote role responsible for supporting daily administrative operations of Fayetteville Childrens Clinic. This role includes answering and routing phone calls, managing electronic correspondence, and providing timely information to patients, families, and clinic staff. The Administrative Assistant will maintain digital records, assist with scheduling, prepare basic documents, and support executive-level administrative tasks when needed. Additional responsibilities include updating databases, organizing virtual files, and coordinating with clinical and administrative teams to ensure accurate information flow. The role requires consistent attention to detail, professional communication, and the ability to manage multiple tasks independently in a remote environment.

**Qualifications**

**- Strong administrative and clerical skills, including Administrative Assistance and Clerical Skills for organizing records, preparing documents, and supporting daily office functions.**
**- Professional phone etiquette and Communication skills to interact effectively with patients, families, and staff across phone, email, and other remote channels.**
**- Experience with Executive Administrative Assistance or similar roles to support scheduling, document preparation, and coordination for leadership or clinical providers.**
**- Proficiency with common office software (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, email, scheduling tools) and comfort working in a remote, technology-enabled environment.**
**- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and work independently.**
**- Prior experience in a medical or healthcare office setting is preferred but not required.**
**- High school diploma or equivalent required; additional training or coursework in office administration or healthcare administration is a plus.**

# Administrative Assistant

$80k - $100k

Astera Institute

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/339673796850989425?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8570355979720724433&crId=US_0US_0)

About Us Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision.
Position Summary Astera Institute is hiring an organized and proactive Administrative Assistant to support key Astera leaders as we grow. Initially, you will support our Head of AI Research and our Head of Strategic Investments. You'll split your time between both leaders, providing day-to-day administrative support while contributing to broader operations as a member of Astera's ops team reporting to our People Operations Manager.
This role sits at the intersection of frontier research and early-stage investing, so you'll work with scientists, founders, and external partners. As an AI-forward organization, we're looking for someone excited about the transformative potential of AI tools, who sees this role as a chance to build that fluency and uplevel their work from day one.
Responsibilities Executive Support (80%) Manage complex, multi-timezone calendars, balancing competing priorities between leaders

Coordinate domestic and international travel and conference registrations (flights, hotels, ground transport, itineraries)

Act as first point of contact for inbound requests, triaging and routing as needed

Own finance admin, including expense reports and reimbursements, procurement (vendor quotes, POs, and invoice tracking), and budget tracking for programs and projects

Prepare meeting materials, including agendas, briefing docs, and follow-up notes

Track action items and follow up on outstanding deliverables

Maintain organized shared drives and filing systems

Coordinate guest and visitor logistics, including meeting rooms, badging, and hospitality

Support research team events, seminars, workshops, and offsites

Coordinate onboarding logistics for new team members, including equipment, accounts, and first-week schedules

AI Research
Schedule and coordinate meetings with researchers, academic collaborators, and external partners

Owning recruiting coordination by scheduling interviews, managing candidate communications, and owning onsite coordination.

Conduct light research (venues, vendors, background on collaborators) and support special projects

Investments
Schedule founder pitches, diligence calls, and co-investor meetings, often on short notice

Help maintain the deal pipeline and CRM, keeping notes and contact records current

Coordinate board meeting logistics and materials

Handle confidential deal, portfolio, and financial information with discretion

Nice to have: Exposure to venture capital, investing, or research environments.

Operations & Cross-functional (20%) Support the Foundation ops team as back up front desk reception coverage

Support the Foundation ops team on projects as they arise, such as vendor coordination, event logistics, or communications support

Serve as connective tissue between supported leaders and Foundation operations

Continuously improve processes and ways of working, with an eye toward what new tools and technology make possible

Qualifications More important than a substantial amount of experience is cultural alignment. Key attributes for success include:
Prioritization & organizational skills: You manage competing priorities across two leaders with ease and re-prioritize independently when things shift. You stay calm under pressure.

Relationship orientation & communication skills: You assume best intent and build positive working relationships with scientists, founders, and partners alike. You use written and verbal communication as an effective and critical tool.

Proactive: You anticipate needs rather than waiting to be asked.

Start-up mentality: You don't hold strong boundaries around what "isn't your job," and recognize this role may evolve significantly over 6-12 months.

Discretion: You use good judgment with sensitive information, including confidential investment and financial details.

Growth mindset: You value giving and receiving respectful, direct feedback. You're excited to learn new tools and techniques that uplevel your abilities and efficiency.

Creative, tenacious problem solving: You see options where others see constraints, and you're energized by delighting stakeholders with thoughtful solutions.

Mission drive: You're motivated by enabling science and ventures that could reshape the future.

Location This role will be on-site 5 days a week in Emeryville, California.
Compensation This role's pay range is $80,000 - $100,000 per year, based on experience, skills, and location.

Litigation Legal Administrative Assistant Details:

Put your administrative and organizational skills to work at Snell & Wilmer, one of the largest and most prestigious law firms in the Western United States. We currently have an opening for Legal Administrative Assistant within the Litigation Practice Group in our Orange County office .

Litigation Legal Administration Assistant provides high-level administrative support to attorneys specializing in litigation. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion. The ideal candidate will have experience in a legal environment and possess a strong understanding of litigation procedures and documentation.

The hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m . in the office .

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

Administrative Support:

Manage and maintain attorneys’ schedules, including arranging meetings, appointments, and travel.
Prepare and edit correspondence, reports, and presentations.
Assist attorneys with case preparation, including organizing and maintaining case files, evidence, and exhibits.
Manage calendars and schedule meetings, depositions, and court appearances.
Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to arrange interviews, depositions, and other case-related activities.

Document Preparation:

Draft, proofread, and finalize legal documents such as pleadings, motions, discovery requests, and trial briefs.
Prepare and file legal documents with courts and administrative agencies, ensuring compliance with procedural rules.
Maintain and update case files, ensuring all documentation is accurately filed and easily accessible.

Communication:

Serve as a liaison between clients, attorneys, and other parties involved in litigation.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence, including phone calls, emails, and faxes.
Prepare and distribute correspondence, memoranda, and reports.

Court and Filing Procedures:

Prepare and ensure timely filing of legal documents with the court.
Monitor and track deadlines to ensure compliance with court rules and procedures.

Experience and Qualifications:

At least 5 years of experience as a legal administrative assistant, or in a similar administrative role within a litigation environment.
Comprehensive knowledge of California court procedures, including state, federal, and appellate levels, with a strong emphasis on e-filing procedures.
Proficiency in legal terminology, procedures, and documentation
Exceptional proofreading and editing skills, with a keen eye for detail in all written communications.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, OneNote, and Outlook) and experience with document management systems.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and within a team, showing reliability and the capacity to juggle multiple tasks effectively.
Excellent interpersonal skills to develop and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of staff and clients.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
High level of discretion and confidentiality.

The pay range for this position is $38.00 to $47.00 per hour depending on years of experience.

Snell & Wilmer offers a competitive performance-based compensation and a generous benefits package starting on your first day. The benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K/profit sharing, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement and paid time off including vacation time, personal time, and sick time where appropriate. Snell & Wilmer values the principles of Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging .

Snell & Wilmer is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

About the Role: Receives operational data for entry into the client's bookkeeping system and determines the best method to record the financial information, such as income, expenses, returned checks, bank charges, and labor hours/codes. Manually records information into the bookkeeping system.
Ensures all checks are endorsed properly and deposited into the proper account each day. Prepares all charge card transactions on the day received. Reports all income and bank charge and information.
Balances and reconciles ledgers, which will become part of the client's general ledger system. Reconciles cash and bank accounts on an agreed-upon basis, comparing account balances to other recorded sources.
Develop detailed reports on a periodic basis for the business client regarding business income, business expenses, gross taxes, and other reports, as needed.
Perform payroll services as requested by the business client account including preparation of payroll checks, preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual employee and employer payroll reports. Prepares payroll in accordance with local, state, and federal wage and hour laws.
Maintains a manual file system to store the hard-copy documents after entry into the record keeping system.
Identifies issues with current process and notifies management of potential concerns and potential solutions. The client is also notified of any issues, concerns and solutions related to the maintenance of the client's financial records.
Participates in meetings and training sessions to continuously improve the bookkeeping service provided to the client.
Attends training related to the effective and efficient performance of job duties.
Other duties, as assigned.
Required Qualifications: Education: High school diploma or equivalent
Work Experience: No previous work experience necessary.

Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit. ### Job Description

Job Description

**Accounts Payable Specialist**

California - Sacramento, CA

**Description**

The Accounts Payable Specialist will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of invoices and vendor payments, ensuring proper approvals, account coding, trust transactions, reconciliations, and resolution of payment inquiries while supporting month-end and year-end close activities.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

- Prioritize and review check requests for appropriate approvals and ensure necessary backup documentation is in place.
- Review aging report for to insure timely vendor payments.
- Review invoices for accuracy of account coding, client disbursements and verification of sales tax for adherence to company policies.
- Handle application of trust and the release of trust payments.
- Research and resolve moderate to complex inquiries concerning account status, payment terms, etc.
- Respond to all internal/external vendor inquires in a timely manner.
- Communicate and assist outer offices as needed with vendor payment inquiries.
- Reconcile vendor statements and research and correct discrepancies.
- Assist in month-end/year-end closing processes and ad hoc projects.
- Send vendor expenses to clients for direct payment, ensuring clarity and promptness in communication.

**Requirements**

- At least 2 years of experience in an accounts payable role.
- Law Firm background.
- Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail to ensure accurate and error-free data entry.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with vendors, tenants, and internal teams.
- Self-driven and able to work independently while also being a collaborative team player.
- Solid understanding of basic accounting principles and procedures.
- Ability to meet deadlines and handle a high volume of transactions efficiently.
- Ability to work independently with good time management skills.
- Experience with invoice processing.

_This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned._

Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards. The Opportunity We are seeking dedicated and driven individuals for the position of PARK PROJECT COORDINATOR
As Southern California's largest employer, LA County offers:
Strong career growth and advancement opportunities
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
A collaborative workforce of 116,000+ professionals
We are seeking a collaborative, organized, and detail-oriented team player to support the Department of Parks and Recreation and coordinate capital improvement and maintenance construction projects. If you enjoy managing meaningful projects, collaborating with diverse teams, and helping improve facilities and public spaces that serve our communities, we want to hear from you!
What You'll Do As a Park Project Coordinator , you'll:
Coordinate construction and alteration activities by conferring with both construction personnel and the appropriate recreation and maintenance personnel to determine their basic requirements, to make convenient arrangements and to provide information on the scope and schedule of the construction.
Inspect and supervise the inspection of all construction projects including capital projects, force account, concessionaire, purchase order contract, service contract, volunteer improvement projects and Urban Beautification projects.
Maintain liaison on capital projects activities with the County Engineer and the Chief Administrative Office.
Interpret the Department's functional requirements to architects, contractors and engineers.
Prepare deficiency reports on capital projects construction and submits them to the Construction Project Manager of the County Engineer for resolution.
Recommend design and specification criteria to the County Engineer to resolve landscaping problems encountered by grounds maintenance working around County buildings.
Prepare the Capital Projects budget for the Department of Parks and Recreation.
Respond to request for information from citizens, community groups, County departments and outside agencies regarding park construction or improvements.
Maintain a file on specifications, working drawings, as-built drawings and construction history on all park construction projects.
**You qualify if you meet one of the following paths:**
Graduation from an accredited college with a degree\* in landscape architecture, engineering, or architecture -AND- three years' experience in the design\*\*, construction coordination\*\*\*, or the inspection\*\*\*\* of buildings or site development. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted on a year for year basis for the required education.

$90k - $125k

York Law Corp
