##### Business Operations Manager with BI Software experience (In Person-Sacramento)

Salary Range: $90,000 – $125,000 (Full-time, on-site)

##### Job Summary

The successful candidate will implement and use business intelligence (BI) tools to analyze performance metrics and lead improvement initiatives across the organization (e.g., DOMO, or Microsoft Power BI). In addition, the Business Operations Manager will be responsible for implementing and managing internal training content using a Learning Management System (LMS) platform to support employee onboarding, skills assessment, and talent development. Lean Six Sigma certification and strong project management skills are essential. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive, results-driven leader with a passion for operational excellence, project management and team development. This candidate will have a strong operations mindset where they will look for bottlenecks in workflows, and look for systems and solutions to optimize systems, solutions, that increase productivity and business profitability.

##### Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage business operations implementing BI software and the existing tech stack.
- Monitor and improve business and team performance through the development of dashboards, data visibility of KPIs, and regular performance reporting using BI software (e.g., Power BI, Excel dashboards)
- Oversee vendor contracts, service agreements, and invoice processing
- Implement Lean Six Sigma and operational efficiency initiatives
- Oversee the design, implementation, and management of training programs and materials for employees across departments using a Learning Management System (LMS)
- Collaborate with stakeholders to identify training needs and track completion and effectiveness of training modules
- Maintain compliance with training and HR recordkeeping requirements
- Lead cross-functional projects that improve workflow, communication, and productivity
- Track and report on project milestones, deadlines, and resource allocation
- Oversee AI Integration and Innovation:
- Identify opportunities for AI, innovation, guardrails, and technology adoption to streamline operations and enhance service delivery.
- Assessing and identifying IT needs and developing scope of work and/or job descriptions to drive internal optimization of legal case workflows and automation.
- Collaborate with IT and leadership to pilot and implement AI-driven solutions (e.g., document automation, data analysis, client intake bots, predictive analytics).
- Train staff and promote a culture that embraces data quality, technology-driven change and continuous improvement.

##### Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management or a related field. Master's degree or MBA preferred.
- 5+ years of experience in business operations, HR, or office management in a professional services setting
- Proven experience using BI software to track and analyze performance data
- Tech-savvy and data-driven mindset towards operations
- People management and coaching skills
- Familiarity with HR systems and Learning Management Systems (LMS) for employee training
- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and project management expertise
- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher strongly preferred)
- Strong communication and leadership skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and workflow documentation tools
- PMI/PMP Certification preferred

##### Preferred Skills

- Experience in a law, accounting, consulting, architecture, medical firm, or software company
- Experience with customizing reports using BI software to measure and manage business and team performance and identify areas for process/performance improvement
- Experience building or customizing training content in platforms like iSolved, TalentLMS, or similar systems
- Understanding of financial and operational performance reporting

##### Benefits

- Competitive salary based on experience
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- Paid time off and holidays
- Engaged, collaborative, and mission-focused team culture

**About Us:**

Join our team at York Law Firm and be a part of a professional services team that advocates for elder abuse and wrongful death victims and their families to ensure justice and accountability for our elders and their families. Our mission is to uncover elder neglect and fraud and to hold bad long term care operators and companies accountable for the exploitation of our seniors. Your commitment to support our team operationally to enable our team to provide high-quality legal case work-up will contribute to ensuring justice for elderly victims swiftly and efficiently within the legal system.

##### Dispatcher

We are looking for a reliable and experienced Dispatcher to schedule and dispatch temporary janitorial team members to various locations.

A good job for someone just entering the workforce or returning to the workforce with limited experience and education. ABM is a military and veteran friendly employer, veterans and candidates with military experience encouraged to apply. Military Occupational Specialty Code: 88N, 92A, LS, YN, 0411, 3531, 2T1X1, 2T2X1

Pay Rate is $17.90

The pay listed is the hourly range or the hourly rate for this position. A specific offer will vary based on applicant's experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.

##### Responsibilities

• Establish and maintain effective communication and working relationships with co-workers, shift coordinators, supervisors, managers, etc. • Schedule and dispatch resources, which may be team members, crews, and teams to appropriate locations according to customer requests, specifications, or needs, using telephones and email.• Ensure timely and efficient movement of team members according to work orders and/or resource schedules.• Oversee all communications within specifically assigned area(s).• Record and maintain files and records of dispatch information including temporary employee time and schedules.• Confer with ABM supervisors and team members to address questions, problems, and requests for temporary coverage.• Compile statistics and reports on work progress.• Other duties as assigned.

##### Qualifications

Required Qualifications:• Must be 18 years of age or older.• No high school diploma, GED, or college degree required.

Preferred Qualifications:• Bilingual in English and Spanish.• One (1) year of prior multi-line reception experience or dispatching experience.• Prior experience scheduling and dispatching 50+ employees.

# Sheriff's 911 Call Dispatcher

$72.12k - $87.65k

Sacramento County, CA

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4156880887906022573?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6484994987671227012&crId=US_0US_0)

**Salary :** $72,119.52 - $87,654.24 Annually

**Location :** Sacramento, CA

**Job Type:** Permanent Full-Time

**Job Number:** 29010-F

**Department:** Sheriff

**Opening Date:** 03/20/2026

**Closing Date:** 12/4/2026 5:00 PM Pacific

**The Position**

**This is a continuous filing exam. Next filing cut-offs are at 5:00 pm on:**

**4/3/26, 6/5/26, 8/7/26, 10/2/26, 12/4/26**

Under supervision, the Sheriff's 911 Call Dispatcher receives telephone reports of emergency and non-emergency incidents from Sacramento County residents, contracting cities, and local, state and federal jurisdictions.

**Examples of Knowledge and Abilities**

**Knowledge of**

• Basic office procedures, methods, and operation of modern equipment including computers and applicable software applications such as word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and other specialized applications related to area of assignment

• English usage, spelling, grammar, and punctuation

• Report writing techniques

• Major streets, highways, and districts in Sacramento County

• Principles of effective customer service

**Ability to**

• Remain calm and courteous while dealing with the public under stressful circumstances

• Deal with highly stressful situations

• Take accurate notes and prepare concise reports using information from callers

• Operate modern office equipment

• Read maps to identify major geographical points and streets inSacramento County

• Learn to operate communications equipment used by the Sheriff's Office

• Analyze situations accurately and take effective action

• Follow written and verbal instructions

• Learn relevant laws, rules, and regulations

• Establish and maintain cooperative, effective working relationships with customers, co-workers, other agencies and the general public

• Communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing

• Analyze situations accurately and adopt an effective course of action

• Effectively organize and prioritize work assignments

• Keep accurate and orderly records

• Maintain confidential information

• Interpret and apply applicable federal, state, and local laws, codes, and regulations

• Apply customer service skills, including the identification of customer needs and follow up to ensure customer commitments have been met

• Speak and understand English clearly and concisely

**Employment Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

Graduation from high school or satisfactory completion of an acceptable General Education Development (GED) test;

**AND**

One year of full-time paid experience performing work where the main duties of the job involved public contact via telephone and/or in person, computer usage, and/or dealing with a high call volume.

**Note:** If the word "experience" is referenced in the minimum qualifications, it means full-time paid experience unless the minimum qualification states that volunteer experience is acceptable. Part-time paid experience may be accumulated and pro-rated to meet the total experience requirements.

**Note:** If the minimum qualifications include an educational or certificate/license requirement, applicants must submit proof of requirements with the application. Failure to submit proof of requirements may result in disqualification from the examination. Unofficial transcripts are acceptable. For guidelines on submitting acceptable proof of educational requirements, please click or speak to someone in our office before the final filing or cut-off date listed in this notice.

**General Qualifications**

POST Requirement:Completion of a California Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) approved abilities assessment test with a passing score is required prior to appointment to this class.

Successful completion of POST Public Dispatchers' Basic Course required within 12 months from the date of appointment. Incumbents in this class are required to maintain POST Dispatchers Certificate through Continued Professional Training (CPT) in accordance with POST recommendations.

Typing Requirement:

Demonstrated ability to type accurately at a net speed of not less than 40 words per minute is required prior to appointment. Failure to demonstrate and maintain this ability may constitute cause for personnel action in accordance with Civil Service Rules or applicable bargaining agreement. Individuals who do not meet this requirement due to disability will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Criminal History and Background Checks:

The County may access criminal history information on candidates who have accepted a conditional offer of appointment for this class consistent with the provisions of Board of Supervisors Resolution No. 82-602, Personnel Policies, and applicable federal and state laws. The County shall not consider for employment any candidate who has been convicted of a felony or misdemeanor that relates to or impacts the candidate's ability to perform the job duties of this class unless it is determined that mitigating circumstances exist. For purposes of accessing criminal history information, the candidate will be fingerprinted. A subsequent arrest notification may be obtained.

The County may also conduct a background check on the candidate prior to appointment to a position within this class. The background check may include personal and professional reference checks, credit history checks where authorized by Labor Code section 1024.5, Social Security Number verification, professional license/registration verification, military service information and driving history. Information obtained in the course of this background check will be considered by the appointing authority in the selection process. In obtaining such information, the County will comply with applicable consent and disclosure practices in the Fair Credit Reporting Act and the California Investigative Consumer Reporting Agencies Act.

License Requirement:

A valid California Driver License, Class C or higher, shall be required at the time of appointment. Failure to obtain or maintain the appropriate California Driver License, or comply with state and federal requirements for utilization, may constitute cause for personnel action in accordance with Civil Service Rules or applicable bargaining agreement. Individuals who do not meet this requirement due to disability will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Security Clearance:

In addition to the Sacramento County Criminal History and Background check, prior to appointment in this class candidates will need to:

1\. Pass a security clearance investigation conducted by the Sacramento County Sheriff's Office.

2\. Successfully pass a medical examination and psychological screening.

Physical Requirements:

Positions in this class require the incumbents to:

• Visually distinguish between, red, green and orange colors.

• Have sufficient hearing to clearly understand speech over a telephone.

• Have sufficient vision to distinguish depth and colors on a computer screen.

• Have sufficient dexterity to constantly use a keyboard and mouse.

• Verbally communicate to exchange information over telephone.

Individuals who do not meet these requirements due to disability will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Working Conditions:

Positions in this class require the incumbents to:

• Work in emotionally stressful situations.

• Work various shifts to provide 24-7 coverage, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

• On a continuous basis, answer a high volume of telephone calls in a call-center environment.

• Wear and maintain a designated Sheriff's uniform.

**Probationary Period**

The probationary period for this classification is **twelve** **(12) months**

Hybrid 32 hours/week $75,000–$92,000 annually DOQ Full benefits

Behind every animal saved and every family kept together is a team doing complex, mission-driven work. At the Santa Cruz SPCA, we're investing in the people, processes, and infrastructure that let us scale our impact — and we're looking for a People Operations Manager to help lead that evolution.

The Role
Reporting to the Executive Director, you'll lead day-to-day Human Resources and help our teams work better together. It's a hands-on role for someone who can handle a payroll deadline and a delicate staff conversation on the same afternoon. You'll:

Manage the full employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to retention and offboarding

Process biweekly payroll and administer benefits

Serve as the go-to resource for staff on HR questions and concerns

Keep HR policies, practices, and the employee handbook consistent and compliant

Lead performance management and coach managers through feedback and tough conversations

Bring structure and facilitation to cross-functional initiatives, and lead select projects

About You
You bring 4-5 years of experience in human resources. You're the person staff trust with hard questions. You’re a compassionate communicator, skilled in navigating differing perspectives, and enjoy helping groups reach alignment. You love building systems that make people and organizations stronger — and you want that work to matter.

Why This Role
A 32-hour week: full-time impact, more time for life

Hybrid schedule and a flexible work environment

Health, dental, and vision benefits

401(k) plan

A passionate team that shows up for animals and each other

As we grow, this role may grow with us. If you want to build the systems behind saving animal lives and keeping pets with the people who love them, we'd love to hear from you.

# Marketing Specialist

$37.94 - $45.53 per hour

Skyline Construction

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4013783044921592353?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3088976455650108424&crId=US_0US_0)

Skyline is Building Better TogetherCome join us at Skyline Construction, a leader in commercial interior construction founded in 1996. Today, Skyline operates multiple offices located throughout California, Washington, and Illinois. Skyline is 100% employee-owned and has been recognized as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces for the past 5 years. We believe that we are “building better together.”
What’s in it for you? The Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing local marketing activities with a strong focus on leading pursuits that drive new business. This includes creating high-quality proposals, presentations, branded materials, public relations content, and other key marketing deliverables that help position the company competitively. In this role, you will ensure that all materials produced and shared internally or externally reflect the highest level of quality, alignment, and differentiation in the marketplace. The ideal candidate is able to handle work that requires rapid turnaround times and strict deadlines, while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.
As a Marketing Specialist you will serve in the following areas: Pursuit Management Manage the full pursuit process including proposals, RFP responses, qualifications packages, and interview presentations.
Write compelling custom content, develop visuals/infographics, and design assets such as resumes, project sheets, and custom proposal pages.
Coach Operations teams on interview messaging and structure. Conduct post interview debriefs and prepare follow up materials.
Project Marketing Coordinate all project marketing efforts including custom jobsite signage, ordering swag / logowear, client gifts, project photography and videography, and other promotional assets.
Coordinate with third party vendors to schedule professional photography and videography.
Develop case studies to market the company’s project portfolio through written content and visuals.
CRM and Data Management Data entry into CRM to support pursuits, resumes/teams, and client information.
Support bid and resource reporting along with related meetings.
Assist with client survey process.
Public Relations Draft and submit press releases, award submissions, and people on the move announcements.
Track media coverage and support companywide PR efforts.
Branding Support the development of branded materials, following companywide brand standards.
Events and Client Engagement Assist with planning and executing internal and external events such as sponsorships, client gatherings, networking events, and recruiting activities.
Coordinate vendors and create supporting presentation materials.
Represent Skyline at company and industry hosted events.
Content Development Brainstorm and develop content with the Marketing Manager and national Branding team.
Produce written content for biographies, project stories, website updates, social media, and internal messaging.
Marketing Strategy and Collaboration Participate in the annual marketing planning process.
Stay current on industry trends and share new ideas to elevate marketing initiatives.
Collaborate with regional and companywide marketing teams to coordinate workload and maintain brand alignment.
The successful candidate will possess: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Graphic Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2+ years of marketing experience, preferably in commercial construction, commercial interiors, architecture, engineering, real estate, or related professional services industries.
Demonstrated experience managing proposals, RFQs, and RFP responses.
Experience supporting business development and client pursuit activities while working with technical staff.
Strong writing and editing abilities through demonstrated content creation and custom proposal content.
Strong graphic design skills used to articulate technical concepts in creative ways through visual communication.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to use AI throughout the pursuit process, content creation and to create efficiencies in everyday tasks.
Proficiency in: MS Office, Adobe InDesign, Photoshop & Canva, CRM platforms
Experience coordinating photography and videography vendor relationships.
Proactively shares ideas and suggests new initiatives
Discreet and able to handle sensitive information in a confidential manner
Ability to multitask and prioritize multiple projects at any given time
Strong work ethic in a highly demanding environment
Critical thinking and good judgment to make decisions
Perks and Benefits Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
Competitive Medical Insurance plan options including an HSA plan with Company deductible contributions.
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
401K Plan Matching
Unlimited PTO
Life Insurance
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Gym reimbursement program

We're looking for a resourceful and proactive Office Manager to be based in our San Francisco office. You'll own the day-to-day running of the workplace, from facilities and vendor management to procurement, logistics, and cross-functional administrative support, keeping everything behind the scenes running without a hitch. You'll also assist the on-site HR management in coordination with headquarters, as needed.
This role goes beyond typical office administration. You'll also have the opportunity to support overseas project operations, coordinate with headquarters, and help create an environment where the team can do their best work. It's a great fit for someone who takes ownership, thrives on variety, and knows how to get things done in a fast-moving startup.
What You'll Do Manage daily administrative operations for the office, including office environment maintenance, office supplies procurement, asset management, and vendor management
Coordinate facility operations, liaise with building management, handle maintenance requests, manage office access, and support a safe and functional workspace
Coordinate client reception, team-building activities, and company events
Assist with on-site HR management, employee onboarding and offboarding procedures
Support overseas project operations including procurement coordination, logistics, and contract and invoice management
Liaise with headquarters on local compliance, documentation submissions, and cross-border administrative coordination
What We're Looking For Required 3-5 years of experience in an office management, administrative, or operations coordinator role
Familiarity with California workplace regulations, including safety compliance (Cal/OSHA) and local business requirements
Experience in managing office vendors, processing invoices, and tracking contracts
Strong organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail
Clear and professional written and verbal communication
Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and proactively identify and solve problems
Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office
Nice to Have Experience supporting overseas operations or cross-border logistics and procurement
Prior experience in a tech startup or fast-growth environment

##### Office Administrator

Baker & Hostetler LLP has an excellent opportunity for an Office Administrator in its Los Angeles office. This position reports to the Los Angeles Office Managing Partner, the San Francisco Partner in Charge, and the Director of Administration. This role will oversee and manage the day-to-day operational and financial activities of the Los Angeles and San Francisco offices.

Responsibilities:

- Oversee the operations of the office, including the overall direction, coordination and evaluation of an administrative team, which includes Human Resources, Accounting, Office Services and Hospitality, Information Technology, Facilities, Records, Reception, and Marketing.
- Develop and monitor the LA and SF office budgets and provide detailed information in support of office budgets for review and approval by the office heads and firm leadership.
- Participate in the LA and SF office strategic and business planning.
- Serve as a liaison between the LA and SF offices and Firmwide departments, including New Business Intake and Conflicts, Billing and Collections, Records and Compliance and Information Services.
- Partner with the Accounting Supervisor to oversee the LA and SF office accounting functions including accounts receivable, accounts payable, expense reimbursement, collections, and trust accounting.
- Collaborate with the Human Resources Generalist to manage attorney onboarding, manage the LA and SF office staff, develop and implement office procedures, address both staff and attorney concerns, provide guidance on personnel matters, deliver staff performance reviews, and support a positive and productive work environment.
- Oversee the operation and maintenance of office facilities, such as directing any maintenance work in the office space and overseeing safety programs, security systems, supplies, vendor contracts, and equipment, while working closely with the Administrative Coordinator.
- Serve as a liaison between the building management company and the firm, including partnering with the Administrative Coordinator to oversee facilities-related activities, such as emergency preparedness, parking programs, janitorial services, and overseeing certain rights and obligations in our lease agreement.
- Plan and execute office events such as staff appreciation events, attorney and office social events, certain client-facing events, and an annual office holiday party.
- Other duties as requested and assigned.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business with a minimum of 10 years of law firm operations experience. Master's degree a plus.
- Strong analytical and communication skills in both written and oral formats. Ability to interact effectively with attorneys, firmwide directors and managers, and other key personnel and exhibit a high degree of responsiveness, diplomacy, and professionalism. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build credibility with firm leadership, attorneys, staff, and clients.
- Excellent organizational and planning skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and projects to meet deadlines with minimal supervision. Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across offices, departments, and firmwide teams. Demonstrate good judgment, tact, and flexibility under pressure in a mixed-matrix environment with many stakeholders and potentially competing priorities.
- Strong project management and leadership skills, with the ability to manage complex initiatives, build consensus among attorneys and staff, and effectively coordinate across departments.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and other business applications, with the ability to quickly learn and leverage new technologies and systems.
- Ability to exercise discretion with confidential and sensitive information and to demonstrate impeccable integrity in personal and fiduciary matters.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work beyond regular business hours as needed to support office operations and business needs.
- Ability to travel periodically to the San Francisco office.

About Us:

BakerHostetler is recognized as one of the leading law firms in the country. With more than 1,000 attorneys located in 18 offices from coast to coast, BakerHostetler is a great place to work for those who seek professional and personal growth in a collaborative environment. We deliver the highest quality counsel to our clients, who include many of the nation's largest and most well-known companies. BakerHostetler's values have remained unchanged since our founding more than 100 years ago: dedication to the law, commitment to the highest standard of client service, continuous development of our people and active participation in the communities in which we work and live.

- Long-term disability benefits

### Job Description

Job Description

SchedulerHelp Build the Plan That Keeps Great Projects Moving

At Dome Construction, successful projects start with a strong plan. We are looking for an experienced Scheduler who can bring project teams together, turn complex construction details into practical schedules, and help our teams anticipate challenges before they affect the work.

This is more than a schedule-maintenance role. You will serve as a strategic planning partner to our Operations, Project Management, and field teams, providing the insights and guidance needed to align resources, sequencing, procurement, trade partner activities, and key milestones. \[\
\
If you enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating with project teams, and using data to help projects stay predictable and on track, this could be a great next step for you.\
\
What You'll Do\
\
As a Scheduler, you will support projects from preconstruction through closeout by:\
\
- Developing and maintaining baseline, master, milestone, conceptual, and recovery schedules\
- Partnering with Project Managers, Superintendents, Project Executives, and trade partners to build realistic project plans\
- Creating schedules that account for construction sequencing, resources, procurement lead times, and critical milestones\
- Supporting pursuit and preconstruction efforts with schedules used for planning, estimating, and client presentations\
- Analyzing critical path activities, constraints, delays, and potential schedule risks\
- Evaluating the effects of design changes, procurement challenges, owner requests, weather events, and field conditions\
- Developing mitigation and recovery strategies with project teams\
- Monitoring progress, forecasting completion dates, and producing look-ahead schedules and variance reports\
- Facilitating schedule reviews, pull-planning sessions, and collaborative planning workshops\
- Presenting schedule updates, risks, and recommendations to project and operations leadership\
- Improving Dome's scheduling standards, templates, tools, and planning practices across projects\
\
What You Bring\
\
- At least three years of experience in construction scheduling, project controls, project engineering, field engineering, project management, or a related construction role\
- Experience developing and maintaining construction project schedules\
- Working knowledge of Critical Path Method scheduling\
- The ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and schedules\
- Experience working collaboratively with project teams, Superintendents, and subcontractors\
- Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or a comparable scheduling platform\
- Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills\
- A bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Engineering Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant construction scheduling experience\
\
Even Better If You Have\
\
- Five or more years of commercial construction scheduling experience\
- Experience supporting multiple projects at the same time\
- Experience leading pull-planning, milestone-planning, or collaborative scheduling sessions\
- Knowledge of schedule risk analysis, delay analysis, recovery planning, forecasting, earned value concepts, or project controls\
- Experience supporting large, complex, or highly phased construction projects\
- A Planning & Scheduling Professional certification or similar credential\
- Experience presenting schedule recommendations to senior project and operations leaders\
\
How You'll Make an Impact\
\
Your work will help project teams identify risks earlier, make informed decisions, and create greater accountability around project milestones. By combining scheduling expertise with construction knowledge and strong relationships, you will help our teams deliver more predictable and successful project outcomes.\
\
This role includes occasional travel to construction sites, Dome offices, client meetings, planning sessions, and other business-related events. Travel will vary based on project assignments and business needs.\
\
Ready to Build What's Next?\
\
If you are a collaborative construction professional who sees a schedule as more than a collection of dates, we would love to hear from you. Join Dome Construction and help our teams transform complex project plans into coordinated, achievable paths forward.\
\
**Apply today and help shape the plans behind Dome's projects.**\
\

Description

Become the Best Part of PMP Management!

PMP is seeking a motivated, detailed, communicative, and personable professional to join our team as Office Administrator, Berkeley Town Homes, Berkley, CA.

Who We Are
Property Management Professionals LLC. (PMP) is an industry-leading association management firm providing innovative products and extraordinary services to common interest developments throughout California, Utah, and Texas. We are proud to offer a personalized, boutique level of service to our association clients, backed by the scale and resources of Odevo, one of the world’s largest resident services companies. We are proud to be privately owned, locally independent, and passionately committed to elevating the lifestyle experience for the communities we serve.

We are one of the fastest (organically) growing association management firms in each of our respective markets. Our company’s growth coupled with the depth and breadth of our network creates a uniquely rare opportunity for professional growth. Additionally, our people-centric culture allows us to attract and retain the industry’s top talent and has served as one of our primary competitive advantages over the past two decades.

To learn more about PMP, our unique approach to community management, and our people-centric culture, you’re invited to visit us online at visit our social media platforms:

Instagram/pmpmanage facebook/pmpmanage linkedin/company/pmpmanagement

Who We’re Looking For
PMP is looking for energetic, passionate, personable, and detail-oriented professionals to join our growing team. The right candidate will embrace change, celebrate innovation, and have an unwavering passion for providing extraordinary customer service to our valuable clients.

Position Summary: The Office Administrator is responsible for providing on-site operations and administrative support to various other branches within PMP to ensure effective communication and coordination across the association.

**Responsibilities & Duties:**

Assist in the preparation of notices, board packets, scheduling of board meetings, and maintenance of corporate records of meetings

Assist in the preparation and distribution of legally required annual disclosure documents as necessary (Annual Budget, Annual Policy Statement)

Assist the board and committees with projects, including document requests, as requested

Receive inquiries and reports from members related to BTH rules and policies and respond appropriately, including bringing items to the board’s attention for further action as necessary (e.g. legal investigation or disciplinary action)

Review incoming correspondence, including invoices, and process and forward as appropriate

Maintain accurate and complete membership records (membership files)

Maintain accurate and complete building operations records (contracts etc.)

Maintain corporate records, including updating of policies, lists and notices

Ensure duties are carried out in compliance with relevant regulatory frameworks for co-ops and HOAs.

Update the Office Manager Handbook to ensure it is up to date

Review financial statements for outstanding issues and budget overruns, and help clarify the nature of expenses as necessary

Purchase office supplies and items related to the building as necessary

Schedule services and obtain quotes for services/contracts as necessary

Report at board meetings and attend board meetings as requested

**Skills & Proficiencies:**

Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

Proficiency in managing software systems and troubleshooting technical issues.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

Experience in facilities management and vendor coordination.

Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and handle multiple tasks effectively.

A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving.

**Education & Experience:**

High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

First-aid/CPR/AED certification may be required or preferred.

Working Conditions
The Office Manager will work under various conditions, including regular onsite office hours with occasional weekends (when requested) and interaction with board members and diverse users.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. The Association will provide reasonable accommodation as needed to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is frequently required to sit, use hands and fingers, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Schedule:** Part-Time (Monday – Friday, ~4 hours/day)

**About Us:**

The Hamilton Building is seeking an organized, welcoming, and proactive Part-Time Administrative Assistant to support our daily property operations and executive team in San Francisco. This is a great opportunity for a professional looking for a consistent, 20-hour weekly schedule in a premier commercial environment.

**Position Overview:**

As the initial point of contact at The Hamilton Building, you will greet arriving clients, tenants, and visitors, determine the reason for their visit, and ensure a seamless, professional office atmosphere. You will support our management staff with clerical duties including answering multi-line phones, making copies, organizing files, and updating our tenant/property databases. While we prefer candidates with prior administrative support experience, we are fully willing to train the right self-starter.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

- Welcome and greet clients, tenants, and office guests with a polished demeanor.
- Support office staff and property management executives with day-to-day clerical tasks.
- Plan and schedule meetings, presentations, office-related events, and travel arrangements; send reminders for upcoming appointments.
- Answer phone calls in a professional manner, direct calls appropriately, or take detailed, accurate messages.
- Type paper and electronic correspondence, manage emails, and prepare outgoing mail and packages for management.
- Assist with the preparation of presentation and leasing materials.
- Monitor and maintain office equipment and inventory supplies; request repairs or restocks as necessary.
- Ensure the leasing and administrative offices remain clean, organized, and welcoming at all times.

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

- High school diploma or GED certificate required.
- 1+ years of experience as an administrative assistant or receptionist is a plus.
- Fast, proficient, and accurate typing skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and standard office equipment.
- Excellent customer service, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Self-starter who works well independently during daily 4-hour shifts.
- Dependable, punctual, and maintains a professional demeanor.

# Administrative Coordinator

$28 - $32 per hour

Dynamic Office & Accounting Solutions

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/968640246103359643?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=282&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8746038397142451096&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Job title:** Administrative Coordinator

**Location:** San Francisco, CA

**Pay Range:** $28-$32/hour DOE

**Work Schedule:** Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-4:30 PM

**Full-Time, Onsite**

**Direct Hire**

We are actively seeking an **Administrative Coordinator to join a busy, fast-paced construction company** . In this hands-on role, you’ll help keep daily office operations organized by supporting scheduling, dispatch coordination, customer communication, documentation, and a variety of administrative needs. You’ll be an important resource for the team, so we’re looking for someone who is dependable, highly organized, comfortable working with QuickBooks, and willing to jump in wherever support is needed.

**To Be Successful in This Role, You’ll Bring**

- Previous administrative or office support experience
- Experience working with **QuickBooks**
- **Construction company experience strongly preferred**
- Dispatching or scheduling experience preferred
- Strong customer service and professional communication skills
- Excellent organization and attention to detail
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy work environment
- A flexible, team-oriented approach and willingness to support different areas as needs arise

**Reasons to Join This Team**

- Enjoy a varied administrative position with exposure to multiple areas of daily operations
- Work closely with customers and internal team members in a collaborative environment
- Take an active role in keeping schedules, records, communication, and everyday office needs organized
- Bring your versatility to a position where your administrative support makes a meaningful day-to-day impact

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

- Provide reliable administrative and office support across daily operations
- Assist with dispatching, scheduling, and coordinating day-to-day activities
- Communicate professionally with customers and respond to questions and requests
- Keep customer information, records, and documentation organized and up to date
- Enter and maintain information in **QuickBooks**
- Follow up with customers regarding **outstanding payments and collections as needed**
- Help resolve routine customer concerns by coordinating with the appropriate team members
- Assist different departments with administrative needs as priorities change
- Help keep the office organized and daily workflows moving smoothly

**Put your administrative and organizational skills to work with a busy, hands-on team.**

### Job Description

Job Description

Description:

As the "face" of the company, you will be responsible for creating a positive first impression for all visitors. As the Front Desk Receptionist, you will provide essential support to grieving families, vendors, and the public. This position requires an individual who demonstrates initiative, sound judgment, and flexibility.

**Responsibilities:**

- Greet and receive client families and visitors of the funeral home and cemetery, maintaining a friendly, empathic attitude, while providing assistance and guidance.
- Receive incoming telephone calls and assist callers with any questions or comments in a polite and professional manner, with a goal to meet or exceed internal and external customer expectations; direct calls to appropriate team members and resolve calls when possible.
- Provide information associated with services on schedule.
- Maintain a comfortable environment, providing beverages and other amenities for the client families as needed.
- Perform a variety of clerical and other tasks, as necessary.


Requirements:

# Executive Assistant

$60k - $90k

Brown Advisory Incorporated

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2513175326944801178?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6618813448069522001&crId=US_0US_0)

Company Overview Brown Advisory is an independent investment management and strategic advisory firm committed to delivering first‑class performance, strategic advice and a high level of client service. We serve individuals, families, family offices, endowments, foundations, charities, institutions, consultants and financial intermediaries with more than 1,000 equity‑owned colleagues worldwide.
Position Summary We are looking for a customer‑service oriented Executive Assistant to support the Office Head in our San Francisco office. The role includes reception coverage, executive support, mail processing, vendor and inventory management, food service assistance and event coordination.
Responsibilities Coordinate communications, take calls, respond to e‑mails, interface with vendors, clients and firm leaders.
Proactively assist and anticipate the Office Head’s needs.
Prepare internal and external corporate documents.
Maintain the Office Head’s calendar, schedule meetings, manage travel itineraries and submit expense reports.
Set up meeting rooms, conference calls and presentation technology.
Maintain contact data, campaigns and dashboards in Salesforce CRM, adding meeting activity, sales opportunities and event information.
Assist the broader team as needed.
Reception Operate a multi‑line switchboard and transfer calls.
Maintain a professional appearance of the reception area.
Greet clients and guests, and coordinate employee arrivals.
Mailroom & Documentation Process and distribute incoming mail daily in line with firm procedures.
Manage incoming and outgoing packages.
Maintain office supply inventory, purchase and vendor escalation.
Receive all incoming mail, deliveries and coordinate courier scheduling.
Internal & External Catering Schedule and assist with set‑up of conference rooms before and after meetings.
Manage food service inventory and develop menus.
Coordinate vendor relationships and place catering orders.
Keep shared colleague spaces and kitchens stocked, cleaned and organized.
Qualifications 3+ years of administrative support experience.
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
Excellent client service skills.
Excellent tact, discretion and judgement with sensitive information.

## Executive Assistant

Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit and your future.

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to join our Levi's Global Brand Team and provide administrative support to four executives. We need an expert multi-tasker who thrives in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment. From event support to meeting coordination and project management, no task is too big or too small for this assistant who handles changing priorities with ease. This candidate understands that success is in the details and is energized by the idea of being a beacon of order and precision for a high-performing team.

### About the Job

Serve as the administrative assistant to four Levi's Global Brand leaders

Manage schedules/calendars, and work cross-functionally with other assistants to schedule complex meetings

Coordinate travel plans

Manage expense reporting

Coordinating and set-up team meetings, offsites, and events

Act as a liaison to other corporate groups on administrative issues

Partner with the finance lead and Levi's Global Brand leadership team on operational items such as managing budgets, tracking expenditures and managing approvals

Manage new employee set up, systems access, desk and hardware set up

Set up new contractors and manage when contractors cycle out

Prepare meeting agendas, schedule conference calls, capture meeting takeaways & action items as needed

Support special projects and ad-hoc requests as requested

### About You

35 years of experience supporting senior executives, ideally in a corporate retail environment.

Experience with extensive international and domestic travel arrangements.

Experience supporting multiple senior leaders simultaneously.

High degree of integrity when dealing with confidential and sensitive information.

Adept at working with different personality types and leadership styles.

Advanced calendaring skills.

Familiarity with Concur or similar tools is helpful.

Flexibility in schedule to staff early morning or late afternoon events.

This is a hybrid work schedule based in our San Francisco, CA headquarters. You will be expected in office 3 days per week typically Tuesday-Thursday. Note, time in office can vary depending on business needs.

The expected starting salary range for this role is $80,600 - $118,100 per year. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. The amount a particular employee will earn within the salary range will be based on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and business needs.

(LS&Co.) offers a total rewards package that includes base pay, incentive plans, 401(k) matching, paid leave, health insurance, product discounts, and more designed to help you and your family stay healthy, meet your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits and incentive compensation vary depending upon the specifics of the role; details relating to a specific role will be made available upon request. Read more about our benefits here.

Assistant Front Office ManagerFour Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.A modern oasis in the city's most exciting location. At the epicentre of San Francisco stands the city's iconic hotel, where business ideas emerge, loved ones connect and life's most important celebrations happen. When you're not shopping at Union Square, enjoying the city's diverse culinary scene or exploring one of the Bay Area's top attractions, unwind in our newly renovated guest rooms, designed to represent the natural beauty of San Francisco's fog, redwood trees and ocean.Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco overlooks Yerba Buena Gardens and is located just steps away from the City's Financial District, Union Square shopping, the Moscone Convention Center, the Museum of Modern Art, and the Contemporary Jewish Museum, amid the city's finest cultural and dining venues.We are actively searching for an experienced and energetic manager to become Assistant Front Office Manager of Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco, supporting Front Office. This position may also provide occasional overnight relief.The Role - Overview This key management role is responsible for all managing the day-to-day operation of the Front Desk. You will direct staff and respond to a wide variety of guest requests, adding personal touches and recommendations with each interaction.Essential Functions This list is not all –inclusive and should only be used as an overview of all actual responsibility.Manages staff in Front Desk Department. This includes training and scheduling staff. Additionally, provides oversight of other Rooms Departments, such as: Guest Services, Concierge, Communications (PBX), etc.Coordinates arrivals, departures and billing requirements with Sales and Catering Department. Blocks rooms for arrivals and ensures any discrepancies are resolved. Reviews daily arrivals to ensure proper handling of Special Attention Guests, Return Guests, and Groups.Assures that all financial and credit procedures are followed. Follows up on credit problems with Front Desk Manager and/or Credit Manager. Reviews all paid-outs, rebates, Petty Cash disbursements and Direct Billings. Checks cashiers' work at end of shift to ensure all transactions are reconciled with proper approvals and endorsements.Takes action in all matters related to the safety, security, satisfaction and well-being of hotel guests and employees when senior managers are not available. Responds swiftly and effectively in any hotel emergency or safety situation.Resolves customer complaints from all areas of the hotel, handling all guest interactions with the highest level of hospitality and professionalism, accommodating special requests whenever possible; assists customers in all inquiries in connection with hotel services, hours of operations, key hotel personnel, in-house events, directions, etc. Responds to all guest requests in an accurate and timely manner. Interaction with guest will be in person and by phone.Checks guest in and out in an efficient and friendly manner, using guest name whenever possible. Assures that guest is assigned type of room requested and the correct rate is charged. Arranges for luggage to be delivered to guest room. Issues correct keys to the guest. Checks out guest at end of stay. Ascertains guest satisfaction, collects keys, posts late charges and presents bill to guest. Settles bill accurately through credit card or cash transaction.Utilizes a variety of computer systems to check guests in and out, run daily reports and select and block rooms for arriving guests.Accepts reservations, changes and cancellations in the absence of Reservations Department Staff. Can answer guest calls and direct them appropriately in the absence of a Communications Operator.Qualifications & ExperienceViable candidates must have a minimum of two years' experience in hotel rooms operations, with at least one year in a supervisory/management role.Knowledge of property management systems required. Opera and Delphi knowledge preferred.Strong business and work ethic required.Candidates with a degree in hospitality, or similar, are preferred.Ability to quickly and positively establish rapport is required.Above average communication skills - both written and oral - are required.Current Four Seasons employees, bilingual candidates and those with prior experience in a luxury hotel/environment will receive priority consideration.Two or more Overnight shifts required.What to Expect:Salary Range: $80K to $84KMarket-leading benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)401(k) Retirement PlanComplimentary Accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and ResortsComplimentary Employee MealsBe yourself and become a member of a work family that cares about you and invests in your developmentMaster your craft here and abroad! Seasonal "Task Force" opportunities are availableEmployee engagement at all levels, where your thoughts and ideas are not only heard but actionedPaid holidays, vacation, and sick daysCulinary, retail and wellness experiences at special rates… and so much more!

Job Description

**About Us:**

_Proudly serving our San Francisco Bay Area communities since 1986, Mollie Stone’s Markets is a local, family-owned grocery store chain. With over 38 years of exemplary performance, Mollie Stone’s Markets continues to make a difference in people’s lives through food. We succeed in the industry by ensuring we deliver a large variety of exciting and quality products in an attractive and positive environment. Our roots remain in healthy, natural and specialty foods. Mollie Stone’s Buyers work closely with local producers around the greater Bay Area to bring high-quality products to every aisle. Our goal is to surprise and delight our customers._

_We pride ourselves on being an employer of choice, and we are proud to offer competitive wages, paid time off, physical and mental health benefits, 401(k) or pension plan, as well as career training programs through our professional partnerships. As a local, family owned and operated business, we are grateful to our customers as they support our vision, which allows us to care for our employees by making a difference in their lives._

**Mollie Stone's is looking for a Full-Time Bookkeeper at our Castro location to be an integral part of the team. This position will require a detail-oriented individual with strong analytical skills, the ability to multitask, excellent time management, and the ability to handle deadlines.**

**Essential Functions:**

- Manage the administration of weekly payroll to the corporate payroll department.
- Processing the daily deposit and balancing the books.
- Complete weekly reports and paperwork.
- Give exceptional customer service and assist customers with any questions they may have.
- Willingness to cashier when required
- Maintain knowledge of weekly ad items; give customers direction to product location throughout the store.
- Restocking inventory, conduct price checks, take “return” products back to proper shelf locations.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Ability to give exceptional customer service.
- Ability to learn new technology.
- A willingness to train/work in other areas of the store as needed.
- Available to work a variety of shifts including mornings, evening, weekends, and some holidays.
- Previous bookkeeping and cash handling experience.
- Available to work mornings and weekends.
- Able to lift a minimum of 30 pounds.
- Local candidates only.
- Must be 18 years or older

**Physical Requirements:**

- Must be able to regularly lift at least 30 lbs.
- Standing: Up to 8 hours per day.
- Walking: Up to 8 hours per day.
- Reaching: Up to 4 hours per day.

**About the Benefits:**

- This is a union position with competitive pay.
- Comprehensive Medical Insurance
- Dental and Vision Insurance
- Life Insurance
- Employee Assistance Program
- Pension Program
- Commuter Benefits
- Employee Discount on Mollie Stone’s Purchases
- Paid Time Off

**Pay range:**

$20.00-$29.98 per hour depending on industry experience

**Why should you apply?**

- You want to enjoy what you do.
- You know what it takes to provide outstanding customer service.
- You would like to join a local, family-owned company who values you.
- You get to enjoy and rely on great benefits and perks for you and your family.
- You’ll have opportunity to learn, grow and advance in your career.

Maison Marques and Domaines USA

Overview:

Maisons Marques & Domaines USA Inc. (MMD USA) was founded in 1987 as the U.S. sales and marketing arm for Champagne Louis Roederer and its California winery, Roederer Estate. Today, the company has grown into a well-respected niche-marketer and importer of family-owned, prestigious producers. In spitea of its growth, Maisons Marques & Domaines has retained the spirit of a small, hands-on company with a very dedicated team. It has built long-lasting, mutually rewarding alliances with key distributors in each U.S. market, based on personal commitment and entrepreneurship. As the wine industry continues to evolve in the U.S., MMD USA intends to remain an outstanding and distinctive ambassador of the wineries it represents.

MMD USA is seeking a Full Charge Bookkeeper to support both Diamond Creek and MMD WineBook CA. The position dually reports to the MEW/DCV Director of Accounting and the MMD Accounting Manager.

The primary role of the Full Charge Bookkeeper will be to support several accounting functions. This position will be an integral part of a dynamic accounting team in supporting a growing and evolving organization. The ideal candidate will embrace and assist with implementation of new technologies where appropriate in order to help build an efficient and scalable accounting and financial reporting operation.

This is a full-time, salaried position with benefits located in our Oakland office.

Diamond Creek Vineyards Winery Accounting (70%)

Accounts Receivable Processing:ALL Post customer invoices accurately for Wholesale and DTC in the Dynamics

Prepare and post bank deposits

Import orders from POS into MS Dynamics

Invoice shipped orders. Enter and post credit card payment deposits for DTC

Monitor customer past due balances and perform collection follow up as needed

Accounts Payable Processing:

Record and code approved invoices and payments in MS Dynamics - Track recurring invoices, insuring all invoices are received for month end close

Process employee expense reports (using Concur) - Prepare and record Wire payments

Prepare company credit card postings and reconciliations to receipts

Process intercompany payables, medical, dental, vision 401(K) etc. - Reconcile monthly vendor account statements and communicate with vendors regarding payment status - Set up and maintain vendor accounts, requesting W-9s as needed

Process year end 1099's

Review GL expense accounts monthly

Track and record capital expenditures with direction from management.

Payroll & Administrative Accounting Support:

Audit timecards and work with managers to ensure timecards are accurate using ADP Time and Attendance

Code expense reports to include in payroll run. Generate various reports in ADP

Answer questions from employees regarding payroll and schedules

Other General Accounting:

Responsible for the timely monthly and quarterly sales tax filings

Responsible for general ledger postings and journal entries

General ledger reconciliations including bank and other balance sheet accounts

Tracking fixed assets and preparing depreciation schedules

Preparing and filing annual property tax returns

Performing month-end closings and preparing the trial balance

Provide back-up accounting support to Merry Edwards Winery as needed

WineBook CA Accounting (30%)

New customer setup in Dynamics (SL and/or Business Central) and on EFT payment portals

Act as liaison between Accounting and customers, including but not limited to: assisting with EFT payment portal onboarding, and helping resolve billing disputes.

Reconcile EFT payment portals to the bank and to MS Dynamics, and take ownership of resolving any discrepancies.

Prepare monthly statements in partnership with the CA sales team

Monitor customer past due balances and perform collection follow up as needed

Perform other ad hoc Accounting-related duties as needed

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

5+ years of progressive bookkeeping or accounting experience, preferably in the wine, beverage, consumer products, or related industry

Ability to work independently with a high attention to detail

Strong verbal and written skills

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, lookups, and data reconciliation.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics SL or Business Central preferred

Experience with ADP is a plus

Associate degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.

Valid California driver's license and ability to travel between company locations occasionally, as needed.

This position is based in our Oakland office and requires regular, Monday through Friday, on-site attendance.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Be seated for long periods of time

Full Healthcare Package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, long-term disability insurance, life, and AD&D insurance

Paid time off

Paid holidays

# Remote Payroll Specialist

$1,200 - $1,500 per month

Full-time

Compass Group

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7338714528478618875?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=258&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1384696980727185520&crId=US_0US_0)

## About Compass Group Compass Group is a global food services and support services organization that partners with businesses educational institutions healthcare facilities and other organizations to deliver essential services. With a focus on operational excellence teamwork and employee support the company relies on efficient administrative and financial processes to help its workforce succeed. Compass Group values accuracy accountability and collaboration across its operations. The payroll team plays an important role in supporting employees by helping ensure that compensation is processed correctly payroll records remain accurate and payroll-related questions are handled professionally.

## Position Summary

Compass Group is seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Remote Payroll Specialist to support payroll administration for employees working across multiple U.S. states. This role focuses on payroll processing employee payment inquiries deduction management and the review of payroll records to maintain accurate and timely payments.

The ideal candidate will have prior multi-state payroll experience strong organizational skills and the ability to manage sensitive information while working independently in a remote setting.

## Primary Responsibilities

- Prepare and review biweekly payroll transactions to help ensure employees are paid accurately and on schedule.
- Maintain payroll calendars processing records and supporting documentation.
- Assist employees with questions about paychecks deductions payment corrections and payroll procedures.
- Monitor payroll support requests and provide timely assistance through phone and email.
- Update benefit deductions and process approved changes affecting employee compensation.
- Review and coordinate short-term disability payment adjustments and related payroll documentation.
- Investigate payment discrepancies and manage requests for canceled or replacement checks.
- Record and maintain wage garnishments court-ordered deductions and other withholding instructions.
- Coordinate with relevant agencies and legal representatives to address garnishment inquiries and documentation requests.
- Prepare wage and employment verification responses in accordance with applicable procedures.
- Review garnishment transactions research discrepancies and coordinate refunds when appropriate.
- Work with accounting and general ledger teams to investigate payroll variances and support account reconciliation.
- Validate payroll reports and system outputs to identify potential errors before payroll is finalized.
- Participate in payroll system updates testing activities implementation projects and team training.
- Identify opportunities to streamline payroll workflows and improve service delivery.
- Follow established procedures for safeguarding confidential employee and payroll information.

## Required Qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent.
- Two or more years of experience processing payroll for employees in multiple U.S. states.
- Working knowledge of payroll deductions garnishments withholding orders and payroll adjustments.
- Strong computer skills including accurate data entry and the use of spreadsheets and payroll systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to organize competing priorities and meet payroll deadlines.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate with colleagues in a remote environment.
- Ability to read write speak and understand English.
- Willingness to work occasional evenings or weekends when business demands require additional support.

## Compensation and Work Schedule

- **Compensation:** $1200$1500 with the applicable pay period to be confirmed.
- **Position Type:** Full-time.
- **Work Setting:** Remote with duties performed from home.
- **Standard Schedule:** Monday through Friday.
- **Additional Hours:** Occasional overtime may be necessary during payroll cycles system updates or other operational requirements.

## Employment Eligibility

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment-based immigration sponsorship is not available for this position.

## Our Approach to the Workplace

Compass Group recognizes the importance of reliable payroll services in supporting its employees and business operations. Candidates should bring professionalism discretion a commitment to accuracy and a willingness to contribute to a collaborative payroll team.

Paul Davis Restoration of San Francisco and the SF Peninsula CA

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- Competitive salary
- Dental insurance
- Health insurance
- Paid time off
- Training & development
- Vision insurance

**Position:** Project Coordinator - Property Restoration

**Reports To:** Owner

**What does a Project Coordinator - Property Reconstruction with Paul Davis do?**

- Support the Project Manager and Mitigation Manager on recon and mitigation jobs from start to completion
- Conduct on-site visits to assess job status, document progress, and communicate updates to the team
- Communicate directly with homeowners, insurance adjusters, and insurance companies on job scope, timelines, and approvals
- Prepare and maintain job documentation including status reports, correspondence, and project files
- Create work orders, maintain job costs log
- Manage job data and track claim status using RMS, Xactanalysis, and Claims Workspace
- Be empathetic and show a sense of urgency when working with homeowners during difficult times
- Public Relations — establish a rapport with insurance carriers, customers, adjusters, agents, subcontractors, and fellow team members


**Why Join The Team?** Paul Davis is an industry leader with over 50+ years in business and 300+ locations nationwide in restoration and reconstruction for insurance providers and commercial properties throughout the United States and Canada. We are growing locally in Northern California and have career opportunities for individuals who want purpose out of their work. We love creating an opportunity for our team members, offering training and seek to promote employees internally.

**Why The Team Needs You?** At Paul Davis, we help homeowners put their lives together after a traumatic event. If you can perform in stressful situations, communicate confidently with homeowners and insurance professionals, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, come join us. Everyone within Paul Davis needs to have a world-class work ethic, serious attention to detail, and a genuine desire to help people. As a Project Coordinator, you will work closely with our Project Manager and Mitigation Manager to keep jobs organized and moving forward; visiting job sites, coordinating with adjusters, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. You will be practicing continuous improvement every day as you build lasting relationships with insurance carriers, customers, subcontractors, adjusters, and fellow team members!

**Team Compensation and Benefits:**

- Leadership Development - our company grows from the inside. If you are determined and motivated enough, ask about participation in our leadership development initiative to grow your career and explore new opportunities
- Paid training
- Health, dental and vision insurance
- Great culture and team dynamic
- Bonus opportunities based on performance

**Team Qualifications (Requirements):**

- Startup mentality — highly organized, proactive, and able to juggle multiple priorities
- Positive attitude with a dedication to world-class customer service
- Strong verbal and written communication skills — comfortable with homeowners, adjusters, and insurance companies
- Tech-savvy and quick to learn new software; experience with RMS, Xactanalysis, or Claims Workspace is a plus but not required
- Experience with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Experience in working with Claude a plus
- Valid driver's license with a clean record and willingness to travel to job sites
- Ability to work nights/weekends and overtime, if needed
- Desire to continually learn new things


Please apply if you think you have what it takes to serve others and deliver a world-class service when others need it the most. We are looking forward to discussing this opportunity with you.

**We support and hire Veterans and we are an Equal Opportunity Employer!**

# Business Operations Manager

Fast-growing software company

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6391039843075339285?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-725542410063721056&crId=US_0US_0)

##### The Role

Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take on a wide-ranging generalist operations seat that blends administration, internal automation, revenue-team support, hiring coordination and supplier relationships. Report directly to company leadership and pick up high-stakes projects as they arise.

##### What You'll Do

Run the company's daily operating rhythm, including internal processes, workplace logistics, and sourcing and negotiating with suppliers.

Handle initial candidate conversations for sales hiring and guide that pipeline through to handoff.

Design and maintain AI-assisted internal workflows, creating new tooling when needs emerge.

Oversee compliance and administrative foundations, including policies, filings, contracts and supporting systems.

Manage sales operations, including CRM upkeep, pipeline reporting and the infrastructure the revenue team relies on.

Plan and execute conferences and events from early planning through on-site delivery.

##### What We're Looking For

Around 1 to 3 years in a generalist or operations-oriented role such as consulting or chief of staff; exceptional recent graduates with demonstrated breadth are also considered.

A high-ownership mindset and willingness to take on work of any size, from routine tasks to complex, leadership-level projects.

Excellent spoken communication, including the poise to handle difficult conversations and run candidate screens independently.

Ease working without detailed direction while priorities shift quickly across several business functions.

Hands-on experience building and maintaining internal workflows with AI tools.

Strong business judgment and a track record of dealing with suppliers on terms and relationships.

Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco for in-person work.

##### Bonus Points

Early-stage startup experience.

Exposure to sales operations or CRM administration.

Experience organizing conferences or events.

Familiarity with compliance workflows such as security audits, contract review or corporate filings.

Experience supporting a founding team in a broad operator capacity.

##### Location And Work Model

San Francisco, CA, United States

On-site (in-person)

Full-time

Zūm Services
