##### Dispatcher

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (Zūm CMX™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – Zūm CMX is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 7,500 schools rely on Zūm CMX. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times' Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

We're seeking an experienced Dispatcher to lead daily transportation operations and serve as the critical communication hub at our San Francisco, CA location. This role encompasses the complete dispatch lifecycle—from daily route assignments and driver coordination to emergency response and real-time problem-solving. You'll ensure seamless service delivery by orchestrating drivers, vehicles, and routes while maintaining constant communication with school districts, families, and internal teams. You'll be the operational heartbeat of our transportation service, ensuring every student gets to school safely and on time, every single day.

You're the calm in the storm, the person who can juggle ten things at once and still remember to check in on that driver who's running five minutes behind. You thrive when the phones are ringing, routes need adjusting, and a bus just broke down on Main Street. You're a quick thinker who stays cool under pressure, makes smart decisions on the fly, and somehow manages to keep everyone informed and on track. You genuinely enjoy being the go-to problem solver, whether you're helping a new driver navigate an unfamiliar route, coordinating with the shop on a repair, or reassuring a parent that their child's bus is on the way. You've got great communication skills, a knack for prioritizing what matters most, and the kind of steady, reliable presence that makes people trust you to get things handled.

Responsibilities:

Daily Operations & Route Management

- Direct and monitor daily assignments, schedule drivers, and assign vehicles to ensure full route coverage and on-time completion of all driver activities.
- Communicate all relevant details of driving assignments to drivers to ensure proper execution, and assist with routing directions and special service assignments.
- Coordinate vehicle service and repairs with the Maintenance Manager to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.

Communication & Emergency Response

- Respond to emergency calls and coordinate the emergency response network.
- Notify stakeholders and location personnel of all route changes, emergencies, accidents, breakdowns, or service disruptions, and handle customer concerns promptly and professionally.
- Provide real-time operational support to drivers including assistance with traffic issues, routing questions, and emergency situations, escalating unresolved issues appropriately.

Compliance & Administrative Operations

- Maintain route documentation and records including contracts, customer information, route changes, maps, vehicle assignments, and driver details to ensure accuracy and compliance with district and state requirements.
- Ensure strict adherence to dispatch standard operating procedures and recommend disciplinary action for policy violations in coordination with management.
- Track and document operational activities, incidents, and communications for reporting purposes while partnering with Location Manager and Safety Manager on compliance objectives.

Requirements:

Basic Qualifications:

- High school diploma or equivalentProficiency with Microsoft or G Suite applications (Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.).
- Experience in high-pressure, time-sensitive operations (e.g., transportation, logistics, field services, customer service, hospitality, or similar fast-paced environments).

Preferred Qualifications:

- Background in a leadership, supervisory, or management capacity within fast-paced operational environments.
- Previous school busing or transportation experience, either as a driver or dispatcher is a plus.
- Knowledge of state DOT/DMV safety rules and company compliance expectations.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills with strong interpersonal abilitiesExperience working in a union environment.
- Comprehensive knowledge of the local area, including traffic patterns, road restrictions, neighborhoods, and geography of the school district is highly desirableStrong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, coordinate scheduling and task assignments, maintain accurate records and filing systems, and track assets and inventory.

Fire Dispatcher Opportunities in Albany
Fire Dispatchers help coordinate responses to fires, rescue incidents, hazardous conditions, and other emergencies handled by fire services. They receive incident information, alert appropriate resources, and maintain communication with responding crews.

This role requires organized information handling and clear radio communication. Dispatchers must keep incident details current while following established response plans and directions from authorized personnel.

Position Details

Duty Location: {airport\_name}, Albany, CA

Employer: The hiring fire service or communications agency identified in the official vacancy

Pay: {salary\_min}–{salary\_max} per year

Schedule: {work\_schedule}

Fire communications operations may require staffing at all hours. Work schedules can include overnight assignments, weekends, holidays, overtime, and additional coverage during major incidents.

What You May Do

Receive and document reports of fires, rescues, alarms, and hazardous conditions

Verify incident locations, access information, and reported risks

Alert stations and dispatch apparatus using approved response assignments

Monitor radio channels, unit availability, and incident status

Relay information about occupants, hazards, and changing conditions

Process requests for additional resources through established procedures

Coordinate mutual-aid communications when assigned

Record dispatch times, unit movements, and significant incident updates

Experience and Education Requirements
A high school diploma or recognized equivalency credential is commonly required. Some employers provide entry-level instruction; others seek experienced dispatchers with fire communications training.

Applicants should be comfortable with computer systems, accurate data entry, maps, and radio communication. Fire dispatch certification, emergency medical dispatch training, or incident-management coursework may be required for particular assignments.

General Conditions of Employment

Meet the hiring agency’s eligibility and minimum age requirements

Complete required background screening and employment assessments

Pass additional pre-employment evaluations when specified

Complete required fire dispatch training and supervised instruction

Maintain certifications and continuing education required for the assignment

Remain available for assigned shifts and emergency staffing requirements

Work Environment and Physical Requirements
Fire Dispatchers usually work indoors at communications workstations with continuous headset, keyboard, and screen use. Major incidents may involve heavy radio traffic and prolonged concentration. The employer determines essential functions and applicable accommodation procedures.

Benefits
Eligible employees may have access to insurance coverage, retirement programs, paid leave, employee-support services, and professional development. Overtime, shift premiums, and other benefits depend on the hiring agency and position classification.

Forward is small in size but big in mind. Everyone here can be innovators that bring in new ideas and explore where the potential exists for the meaningful reform.

WHAT DO WE DO?
Forward Logistics is an intrastate and interstate motor carrier specializing in Loose Cargo Load (LCL), Full Container Load (FCL), Full Trailer Load (FTL), oversized cargo, and special project cargo delivery. In human words, we move cargo from point A to point B on the road with a truck.

ARE YOU ONE OF US?
The Customer Service Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for customers by providing timely responses to rate requests, shipment status inquiries, and general service-related questions. This position works closely with Operations, Dispatch, Billing, and other internal departments to ensure customers receive accurate information and exceptional service while supporting daily administrative and reporting functions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Respond promptly to customer inquiries regarding transportation rates, shipment status, service availability, and general account information.

Prepare and provide accurate freight quotations while ensuring pricing aligns with company guidelines and service capabilities.

Coordinate with Operations, Dispatch, Warehouse, and other departments to obtain shipment updates and ensure accurate customer communications.

Monitor pending quotations and follow up with customers as appropriate.

Enter, update, and maintain customer, pricing, and shipment information in the transportation management system (TMS) and other internal databases.

Generate reports using the TMS, Microsoft Excel, and other business applications to support customer requests and internal operations.

Maintain accurate records of customer communications, quotations, and service activities.

Assist in resolving customer concerns by coordinating with internal teams and following issues through to completion.

Communicate professionally with customers, vendors, and internal departments to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and recommend operational efficiencies.

Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

Minimum one year of experience in trucking / transportation field.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong organizational and analytical skills.

Strong ability to multi-task and to prioritize in a fast paced environment.

Proficient in Microsoft Office and professional e-mail etiquette.

High school graduate required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Bilingual in English and Chinese (Cantonese/ Mandarin) a plus.

401(k)

401(k) matching

Health insurance

Paid time off

Pay: $23.00 - $27.00 per hour

FORWARD TOGETHER
Forward Logistics is an employee forward company. We know that life comes first and want you to take the time you need with our accrued paid time off program. We offer health and dental insurance, 401K, career advancement, and more.

We hope one day we will tell you, “Welcome to the Forward family!” We mean it. Contact us if you have any questions or if you are ready to join us. Together, let's go forward.

### Job Description Job Description **Role Summary** The Dental Office Manager plays a pivotal leadership role in overseeing the administrative operations of the dental practice. This position is responsible for supervising front office staff, optimizing practice revenue and collections, ensuring regulatory compliance, coordinating patient scheduling, managing expenses, and maintaining a positive, efficient work environment. The manager serves as the liaison between staff and upper management and is instrumental in achieving clinical financial and service goals. **Essential Role Responsibilities** The Office Manager ensures operational excellence by leading staff, managing finances, and supporting patient satisfaction.  01. Oversee daily operations of front office and administrative functions. 02. Manage scheduling for all dental providers; optimize production and reduce idle time. 03. Lead front desk team, ensuring proper training, coverage, and workflow. 04. Monitor and report on daily revenue and collections; identify missed collections and follow up with patients. 05. Administer and monitor accounts receivable, including billing, collections, and financial arrangements. 06. Maintain compliance with HIPAA, OSHA, and safety regulations. 07. Coordinate ordering and inventory management of dental and office supplies. 08. Perform chart audits, track provider production, and ensure accurate fee schedule use. 09. Lead daily huddles and monthly staff meetings; communicate goals and performance metrics. 10. Manage payroll-related duties and monitor labor costs. 11. Ensure accuracy of patient insurance information and benefit verification. 12. Respond to patient feedback and satisfaction surveys, taking corrective action when necessary. 13. Enforce practice policies including dress code, attendance, and professional behavior. 14. Provide ongoing feedback, training, and coaching to team members. 15. Maintain clean, organized, and patient-ready office environment. 16. Handle marketing initiatives and local community outreach efforts. 17. Oversee new treatment plan consultations when necessary. 18. Prepare financial and performance reports for upper management. 19. Perform other administrative and leadership duties as assigned. 20. Verify and file all patient insurance claims promptly and accurately. 21. Work all accounts receivable (AR) reports according to office policy; maintain account activity. 22. Identify patients arriving with delinquent accounts and coordinate front desk follow-up. 23. Send delinquent accounts to collections per office policy. 24. Post all patient collections. 25. Perform daily reconciliation process. 26. Complete all reports for the practice and Finance Department on time. 27. Assist with cleanliness and organization in all office areas. Own your space. 28. Support and participate in staff meetings and team collaboration. 29. Demonstrate flexibility and teamwork by assisting other departments when needed. **Role Qualification Guidelines** **_Required Role Qualifications_** 1. High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor's degree preferred.  2. Minimum 2–4 years of dental office or healthcare management experience.  3. Demonstrated knowledge of dental insurance and practice management systems.  4. Proven financial and analytical skills.  5. Strong leadership, coaching, and team-building capabilities. **_Preferred Role Qualifications_** 1. Experience with Denticon or similar software.  2. Training in HR and employee relations.  **_Required Licenses or Certifications_** 1. Completion of HIPAA and OSHA training.  2. Certification in dental office management or healthcare administration preferred. **Core Capabilities for Success** The following are key attributes that are necessary for successful performance in the role. These capabilities are not required for the role and individuals may not exemplify all attributes of the capabilities outlined. However, the core capabilities should receive strong consideration when determining success or identifying a successful candidate for the role. **_Knowledge and Skill_** 1. Advanced understanding of dental operations and insurance processes.  2. Proficiency in reporting, budgeting, and workflow planning. **_Talent and Ability_** 1. Strategic thinker with a hands-on management style.  2. High emotional intelligence and effective decision-making. **_Personality Traits_** 1. Proactive, accountable, and adaptable.  2. Confident communicator and problem-solver.

Full-time

**About Zephyr Rail**

**Zephyr Rail is an engineering design and construction management firm based in Orange, CA. We specialize in providing comprehensive solutions in railroad design, construction management, and UAV solutions. We are proud to have earned Zweig Group’s recognition as a “Best Firms to Work For” for four consecutive years, demonstrating our commitment to our team and our industry.**

**Job Summary**

**This is a combined office management and project administration position, with primary responsibility for keeping an integrated project management/construction project office organized, well-equipped, and running smoothly. The Project Office Manager will oversee daily office operations, facilities, supplies, meeting logistics, and staff support, and assist the project management team with meeting minutes, correspondence, document control, tracking logs, and coordination with clients, contractors, and design consultants. We are seeking a hands-on, proactive professional who can independently manage competing priorities, anticipate team needs, and follow through on details in a fast-paced project environment.**

**Responsibilities**

**- Oversee day-to-day project office operations and maintain an organized, efficient, and professional work environment.**
**- Manage office supplies, equipment, furniture, and related purchases; maintain inventories, track orders and deliveries, and coordinate with vendors and service providers.**
**- Coordinate office space and facility needs, including workstations, conference rooms, maintenance, access, IT support requests, and office setup or changes.**
**- Arrange meeting logistics, calendars, conference rooms, virtual meeting connections, site visits, and project events.**
**- Support onboarding and offboarding of project personnel, including workspace preparation, access requests, equipment coordination, and orientation to office procedures.**
**- Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for office-related matters and coordinate as needed with project staff, clients, contractors, consultants, and service providers.**
**- Maintain office procedures, staff contact lists, records, shared files, distribution lists, and administrative trackers; identify opportunities to improve office workflows.**
**- Assist with routine administrative tracking, including timesheets, other direct cost (ODC) logs, expense records, invoices, office orders, and related reporting.**
**- Prepare meeting agendas and materials; attend meetings, draft and distribute clear, accurate minutes, and maintain and follow up on action-item logs.**
**- Prepare, format, and distribute project correspondence, memoranda, presentations, spreadsheets, and periodic status reports.**
**- Support document control staff with organizing, filing, logging, routing, distributing, retrieving, and archiving project documents in accordance with established procedures.**
**- Support the Office Engineer and project team in tracking correspondence, requests for information (RFIs), submittals, and other project deliverables; follow up with responsible team members on administrative status and deadlines.**
**- Coordinate routine communications and information requests among the project management team, client representatives, contractors, and designers, elevating technical or contractual matters to the appropriate personnel.**
**- Provide administrative support for project records, office operations, and other related duties as assigned.**

**Qualifications**

## PM-Office Coordinator - The Hollywood Roosevelt

Dating back to the Golden Era and located on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, The Hollywood Roosevelt is an iconic hotel that reflects classic Hollywood in every sense. Built in 1927, the hotel has played host to stars like Marilyn Monroe, Charlie Chaplin, and Clark Gable. Hollywood Roosevelt is a full-service lifestyle hotel providing guests a glimpse at Hollywood's storied past and offering travelers an experience of Hollywood that is authentic to its history and legacy. Experience our modern interpretation of a Hollywood original.

The PM Housekeeping Office Coordinator will effectively support the office needs of the Housekeeping department. The job duties require style and service attributes that are key to creating a positive guest experience.

What You'll Do

As the PM Housekeeping Office Coordinator, you will play a key role in keeping the department running smoothly. You will manage daily staff schedules, track room attendants' productivity and overtime, coordinate staffing needs, and prepare daily room assignments. You will log guest requests, lost and found items, and shift information in the Alice system, while maintaining clear communication through radios, emails, and pass-down books. Additionally, you will ensure that all hotel policies, safety procedures, and appearance standards are consistently upheld, supporting both guests and your team.

In this role, you are directly contributing to a positive guest experience and the overall efficiency of the housekeeping department. Your efforts will ensure that rooms are clean and organized, staff is well-coordinated, and guest requests are handled promptly and professionally. By keeping the operation running smoothly, you help create an environment where both guests and employees feel valued, supported, and confident in the quality of service provided.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive individual to join our Housekeeping team as a PM Office Coordinator. The ideal candidate excels in customer service, communicates clearly with both guests and staff, and can efficiently manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced hotel environment. Experience with hotel operations, particularly housekeeping, and familiarity with systems like Alice are preferred. You are someone who can handle unexpected challenges with professionalism, prioritize work effectively, and maintain a polished, professional appearance while fostering a positive team environment.

Why The Hollywood Roosevelt

Join The Hollywood Roosevelt, an iconic Hollywood hotel, where you can grow professionally, be part of a high-performing team, and help create memorable experiences for every guest. Your work matters, and every day brings the chance to contribute to a world-famous, vibrant environment.

Apply now and join the team!

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.SALES OPERATIONS MANAGER (ENABLEMENT)Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation delivering high-speed, low-latency broadband to customers around the globe. As the Sales Operations Manager on the Starlink Enterprise team, you will own the systems, programs, and content that turn new and existing sellers and account managers into high-performing revenue generators. You will design and execute structured onboarding and continuous development programs, create high-impact sales assets, and partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Channel, Product, and trusted advisor to sales leadership on skill gaps, performance trends, and enablement investment prioritiesBASIC QUALIFICATIONS:Bachelor’s degree5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales Maintenance Scheduler Full Time Luke AFB, AZ, US
2 days ago Requisition ID: 1159
The Maintenance Scheduler supports aircraft maintenance operations by coordinating and scheduling maintenance activities, managing maintenance records and technical documentation, and ensuring the accuracy of aircraft configuration and maintenance data. This role partners with cross‑functional teams to support regulatory compliance, fleet readiness, and the efficient execution of maintenance programs. The information below is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required for this position.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Monitor aircraft and component data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity, notifying management of factors affecting aircraft health or airworthiness.
Collect, analyze, and prepare reports and briefings using maintenance information system data to support operational decision‑making.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the maintenance information system (RAMCO), ensuring proper system utilization, data integrity, and sustainment.
Maintain permanent aircraft and component records by verifying maintenance documentation, performing comprehensive record audits, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company requirements.
Coordinate with Maintenance and Logistics to schedule maintenance activities, ensure workflow alignment, and confirm parts availability for scheduled and forecasted maintenance.
Manage aircraft configuration control by tracking modifications, repairs, and maintenance status, developing implementation plans for fleet‑wide modifications as applicable.
Create aircraft work packages for heavy maintenance events and update planning trackers to support maintenance planning, material forecasting, and procurement.
Track, update, and report aircraft status to leadership, ensuring the timely completion of scheduled maintenance in accordance with applicable flight authority requirements.
Assist with management of the TAC Controlled Document Library, including the distribution and maintenance of Technical Orders (TOs) and other controlled maintenance documentation.
Support Egress personnel with aircraft configuration control and explosive component documentation.
Conduct Compliance Order status reviews and elevate issues requiring leadership attention.
Initiate LLP or TBO component extension processes in accordance with the Aircraft Inspection Program (AIP).
Create and manage work orders to ensure timely closeout, proper component return to inventory, and accurate maintenance documentation.
Track CANN actions, coordinate replacement part orders, and review goods receipts to ensure proper documentation and required ERKs updates.
Maintain compliance with company policies, procedures, and quality standards.
Perform other duties as assigned.
SKILLS AND/OR QUALIFICATIONS
Working knowledge of Federal Aviation Administration regulations and Military maintenance reporting procedures.
Proven track record of success working on complex assignments requiring considerable judgment, initiative and technical/specialized knowledge.
Possesses a strong understanding of aircraft maintenance lifecycle, inspection intervals and discrepancy management.
Excellent written and oral presentation of aircraft maintenance and configuration information.
Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines while fostering a positive attitude and maintaining an exceptional level of attention to detail.
Must have strong problem‑solving abilities.
Proficient in the English language with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Must be proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite.
Must demonstrate safe and healthy workplace practices.
Must be able to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
Must be able to travel within the US and internationally.
Must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities of a Heavy Maintenance Scheduler in daily work performance.
Must be able to work in various weather environments and conditions.
Must be able to obtain a Common Access Card (CAC) and not be barred from any installation.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
EDUCATION AND/OR WORK EXPERIENCE
High school diploma or GED.
Minimum 3 years’ experience in aircraft maintenance operations required.
Experience with the F-16 platform desired.
Experience in production, scheduling, or maintenance analysis is strongly preferred.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Ability to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer.
Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment with standard lighting, noise levels, and climate conditions.
This role may be performed around loud noises and hazardous chemicals with exposure to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals.
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Senior Primavera Scheduler (Primavera P6)**

**Contract:** 6-month duration

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, in office

**Location:** Pico Rivera, CA

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior Primavera Scheduler** with deep technical expertise in **Primavera P6** to support program-wide scheduling and resource-loading initiatives. This role focuses on improving schedule accuracy, transparency, and execution across multiple concurrent projects through disciplined resource and cost modeling.

A successful prototype is already in place. This role operationalizes and scales that effort within internal planning systems. In short, this is not theoretical work.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Perform detailed resource and cost loading in Primavera P6 on a program-wide master schedule.
- Align project timelines with available labor, material, and equipment capacities.
- Support what-if scenario planning, workload balancing, and resource prioritization.
- Improve forecasting accuracy and identify resource constraints early.
- Provide visibility into resource demand across concurrent projects.
- Coordinate with Project Managers, discipline leads, and Project Controls to validate schedule inputs.
- Maintain accurate, transparent, and audit-ready scheduling data and reports.

- Advanced, hands-on experience with Primavera P6.
- Proven expertise in resource loading and cost loading within Primavera P6.
- Experience managing program-level or portfolio-level master schedules.
- Strong working knowledge of schedule logic, critical path, and forecasting techniques.

- Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex, multi-project environments.
- Direct collaboration experience with Project Managers and Project Controls teams.
- Ability to translate project inputs into accurate, actionable scheduling data.
- Experience identifying and resolving resource bottlenecks and capacity conflicts.

**Requirements:**

- Advanced, hands-on Primavera P6 experience, not read-only or reporting use.
- Proven resource loading AND cost loading experience within Primavera P6.
- Direct ownership of program-level or portfolio-level master schedules, not single-project only.
- Strong command of schedule logic, critical path method (CPM), and forecasting techniques.
- Demonstrated ability to perform what-if scenario planning and workload balancing in P6.

- Experience operationalizing scheduling initiatives beyond pilot or prototype stages.
- Background in public infrastructure, utilities, or large capital programs.
- Strong analytical and reporting skills to support leadership decision-making.

About SoLo Funds
SoLo Funds is a leading FinTech company empowering financial autonomy for underserved communities. Launched in 2018, SoLo is an on-demand marketplace where members can request and fund emergency loans - without predatory interest rates. We are VC-backed, supported by Techstars, and have strategic partnerships with Visa and Kiva.
Contractor Role
We are looking for a highly organized office assistant to support the day-to-day operations of SoLo Funds and help ensure the company runs smoothly. This role combines office operations and executive support, helping manage logistical details across the company while assisting the executive team with scheduling, travel coordination, and administrative priorities.
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and enjoys keeping things organized behind the scenes so teams and leaders can focus on their work.

Track key action items and help ensure cross-team follow-through
Coordinate shipping and receiving of company equipment and lead onboarding logistics for new hires
Support special projects and company initiatives as needed
You're a Great Fit if You Have 2+ years of experience in office management, operations or executive support
Are highly organized and detail-oriented
Anticipate needs before they arise
Communicate clearly and professionally
Thrive in fast-moving, startup environments
Handle confidential information with strong judgment and discretion

Bonus Points Experience working at a startup or high-growth company
Experience coordinating investor, board, or partner communications
Familiarity with workplace tools like Google Workspace, Slack, and calendar systems
Interest in fintech or mission-driven companies

## OFFICE SERVICES AND OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

## DEPARTMENT: OFFICE SERVICES

## STATUS: NON-EXEMPT

Job Description
The Office Services and Operations Coordinator provides administration, secretarial and clerical support to others in the office to maintain an efficient office environment. This person is responsible for all office services tasks with various departments within the agency on any issues, office services, reports and other special projects assigned by management.

Momentous Insurance, A Marsh McLennan Agency provides commercial insurance, commercial entertainment, film and tv insurance, employee health & benefits insurance, and private client insurance solutions to organizations and individuals seeking limitless possibilities. With 9,000 colleagues and 170 offices across North America, we combine the personalized service model of a local consultant with the global resources of the world’s leading professional services firm, Marsh (NYSE: MRSH).

Location
Van Nuys, California

Position Requirements

Facilities Maintenance- Van Nuys and Torrance

Coordinates mail—collecting and mailing correspondence: copying information, scanning mail to remote employees.

Oversee postage machine orders.

UPS, Messenger, and mail service checks & balance.

Maintains supplies by checking inventory levels; anticipating requirements; placing and expediting orders; verifying payments and receipts; confirming customer orders, keeping staff informed on orders; stocking items; delivering items to work stations.

Provides New Hire supplies

Assist covering the reception desk, answering questions, and forwarding messages.

Restocking supplies in both kitchens.

Miscellaneous tasks, working along with accounting.

Track Licensing for the Agency and Employees

Any other duties and special tasks as assigned by management.

Preferred Skills And Abilities

Minimum of two years of Administrative support experience.

Computer skills as well as a working knowledge of the basic accounting software programs.

Detailed oriented, highly organized, and multi-task oriented.

Willing to learn and take initiative.

Physical Actions

Required job duties are essentially sedentary work consisting of occasional walking, standing and lifting and/or carrying 20 lbs. maximum.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate-controlled office environment.

Education Requirements

High school diploma along with completed college courses in accounting preferred.

Special Skills Requirements

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Strong follow up skills

Results oriented

Fosters a customer service orientation

Sound problem-solving skills

Consistent exercise of good judgment

Prioritize and complete multiple tasks simultaneously

High integrity

Ability to routinely work under pressure, meets deadlines

Work independently and in collaboratively with a team.

Valuable Benefits
We value and respect the impact our colleagues make every day both inside and outside our organization. We’ve built a culture that promotes colleague well-being through robust benefit programs and resources, encourages professional and personal development, and celebrates opportunities to pursue the projects and causes that give colleagues fulfilment outside of work.

**Some benefits included in this role are:**

Generous time off

Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities

Charitable contribution match programs

Stock purchase opportunities

##### Receptionist/Administrative Assistant

# Litigation Administrative Assistant

$75k - $100k

Nelson Mullins Riley & Scarborough LLP

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2534162539112237696?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1267345808488829941&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Overview

Nelson Mullins, an AmLaw 100 firm, is seeking a Litigation Administrative Assistant to join our collaborative team in our Downtown Los Angeles office. In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting attorneys and paralegals on a variety of complex commercial, civil, and defense litigation matters. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced professional to provide high-level legal and administrative support while working alongside talented colleagues in a dynamic and supportive environment.

##### A Day in the Life

The Litigation Administrative Assistant will play an active role in assisting with the management of each attorney’s caseload by maintaining attorney calendars, making travel arrangements, and processing monthly expense reports. You will be responsible for preparing, revising, and finalizing correspondence, pleadings, and other legal documents, as well as performing electronic filing (e-filing) in various courts and jurisdictions. You will schedule depositions, mediations, and other client meetings, and communicate with clients as necessary. Experience supporting attorneys through all phases of litigation, including trial preparation and attendance, is preferred. Additional responsibilities include running conflict checks, opening new client/matter engagements, maintaining electronic files, setting up billing requirements for clients, maintaining and updating contacts, assisting with billing and client invoices, and handling other clerical assignments as delegated.

##### We Know You

We are looking for a skilled Litigation Administrative Assistant with at least four years of recent State and Federal litigation experience in a law firm environment. In this role, you’ll thrive in a fast-paced setting where deadlines are tight, and priorities can shift quickly. We value proactive, self-starting professionals who take ownership of their work and enjoy collaborating with attorneys, paralegals, and fellow administrative team members. Strong writing and communication skills are essential, as you’ll regularly interact with colleagues, clients, and attorneys. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite is required, and experience with document management systems, docketing systems, and billing or time entry programs will make you stand out.

At Nelson Mullins, we are dedicated to transparent and fair compensation practices. Pay for this position is determined by factors such as experience, skills, and location.

- **Salary/ Wage Range**\- $75,000 to $100,000 annually. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for merit-based raises and benefits such as healthcare, retirement plans and paid time off.

##### Who We Are

With more than 1,000 attorneys, policy advisors, e-discovery professionals and other business professionals across offices in California, Colorado, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, West Virginia, and throughout North Carolina and South Carolina, Nelson Mullins has strong roots in the business community and an appreciation for new directions in the business world.
